subject: A message from the Squad Victory Fund
body:
[1]Squad Victory Fund

Hi Peter — AOC, Ayanna, Cori,
Ilhan, Jamaal and Rashida here!

If you haven’t already heard, all six of us are gearing up to meet a very
important deadline at the end of the month. The Federal Elections
Committee (FEC) first quarter fundraising deadline is this
Friday, Peter, and we’re hoping to
reach our goal of raising an additional $25,000 before the clock strikes
midnight.

Reaching this goal, for the first time as a newly expanded Squad, would
show our opposition the true strength of our movement — and make clear
that we aren’t going anywhere. But we can’t do this without you.

If you’re ready to join in on the action and support our Squad right now,
please consider making a donation of any amount to help us close the gap
on our goal and kick off Q2 in the strongest position possible.

We’ve even provided you with your very own personal link so you can make
your donation as soon as possible:

[ https://act.coribush.org/go/1094?refcode=em20230330-2426&t=1001&akid=2426%2E1082990%2EjV1vc0 ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/svf-cori-20230330?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com

We’ve grown so much since our Squad first got to Congress in 2018. And we
know that, with you on our side supporting each and every one of us, we’ll
be able to accomplish even more in the future.

But the truth is, we need to ensure we have the resources, tools, and
funding to keep pace with our collective vision. And we’ll need all the
support we can get if we want to keep advancing life-changing policies in
Congress.

The full strength of our Squad is undeniable,
Peter. And our opposition knows it — that’s why
they’re gearing up to throw everything they have into unseating us and
diminishing our progressive power. Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen.

A contribution from you today — before our end-of-quarter deadline — will
help boost our campaign resources, show the true strength of our movement,
and keep us on the path to victory. So, if you stand with us, please use
the personal link below to make a contribution to our movement today.

[ https://act.coribush.org/go/1094?refcode=em20230330-2426&t=1002&akid=2426%2E1082990%2EjV1vc0 ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/svf-cori-20230330?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com

Thank you for your continued belief in the work we’re doing together.
Without you, none of this would be possible.

Together,

Alexandria, Ayanna, Cori, Ilhan, Jamaal, and Rashida

body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/42576?t=6&akid=6811%2E878179%2EB-N45_) Hi, it’s Sen. Sherrod Brown from Ohio. I’ve spent my life fighting for the Dignity of Work – and I mean _all_ work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I’ll fight for you.

I’m running for reelection so I can _keep_ fighting for workers and families in the Senate – but I need your help. As the only remaining statewide Democrat in Ohio, analysts at _CNN_ say I’m one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot – and national Republicans are already launching attack ads against me.

**The battle for Senate control could all come down to Ohio – so please, I’m personally asking:** [Will you give $10 or more right now – split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project – to help defend this battleground seat and keep the Senate blue?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/42576?t=7&akid=6811%2E878179%2EB-N45_)

I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. And I’ll be honest with you: The Ohio I live in now looks a lot different than the one I grew up in. I’m fighting in the Senate every day to bring those jobs back, to build our economy by investing in the middle class, and to ensure hard work pays off for every American.

But I’m facing my toughest race yet – in a state Donald Trump won by 8 points. Last year’s Ohio Senate race was one of the most costly and competitive in the nation, and _NBC News_ reports that this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”

**The long and short of it is, I can’t win – and Democrats simply can’t hold onto our narrow Senate majority – if we don’t have strong grassroots support from folks like you.**

[That’s why I’m asking for your support today: Please, will you chip in $10 or more now – split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project – so we can win in Ohio and defend the Senate?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/42576?t=8&akid=6811%2E878179%2EB-N45_) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sherrod Brown and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/42577?t=9&akid=6811%2E878179%2EB-N45_)

_This included putting her on experimental drugs like**Lupron** , a drug that has been used to chemically castrate violent sex offenders..._

_... Giving her constant testosterone injections..._ _... “Would you rather have a dead daughter or a live son?”
---

Medical facilities are actively promoting, encouraging, and advertising these barbaric treatments to minors. Chloe has suffered physically, socially, emotionally, and psychologically from their lies and experiments. Chloe also has no idea if she’ll ever experience the profound joy of motherhood... and if she is able to one day have kids, she knows she will not be able to breastfeed them. The medical experimentation performed on Chloe as a young child caused permanent and irreversible damage to her body and the predators that did this must be held accountable... ...and that’s where you come in. [**Please make an urgent donation of $25 today - but of course if you can give more, say $35, $50, $100, $250 or more I would be eternally grateful. **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rG3B%2fETOMDEKhxxxdmm0Jw&sysid=1) Whatever amount you’re able to give today will be used to hold these radical activists pushing this disgusting agenda on our children accountable. ** **

---
| So please, do not delay. Chloe’s landmark case is the case that can put a stop to these “physicians” abusing and mutilating children... With your help we can save many more lives like Chloe's.

_**UPDATE:**_ We told you several days ago that District Attorney Alvin Bragg's handpicked Grand Jury was going to indict President Trump and _**the so-called conservative media WAS LYING!**_

And now that we've all been hit with a huge reality bomb it's time for all patriotic Americans to make a choice...

**_[Are you going to just talk or are you going to stand with President Trump?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502334:J_VKvXGRN:m:1:3365131770:ABA60685AC548DC8ECD11A330A7E5288:r)_**

Alvin Bragg and the radical left just declared war on you and your values... It's time to fight back...

Are you going to be like one of those little old ladies in church who virtue signal and shout _'Amen'_ and proclaim to anyone who is willing to listen that they're going to _'pray on it'_ when they really have no intention of doing anything?

Again... it's time to choose...

* * *

_**Don't Let The Radical Left Bully You.**_
The First Amendment to the Constitution of the United States clearly says that you have the God-given right to _" petition the Government for a redress of grievances."_

Don't let the Radical Left bully you or shame you into thinking otherwise.

It doesn't matter what they think... it doesn't matter what your relatives or co-workers think... it doesn't even matter what we think...

Dear Friend, **I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.**

**I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.**

But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.
**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. **Joining the Sun costs as little as $0.01 per day.** I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

VCDL 2023 Legislative Scores Released
Senator Amanda Chase Receives 100%
8 Years in Row

Senator Amanda Chase is the Only Candidate Running in Senate District 12 with a Sold 8 Year Voting Record from VCDL

CHESTERFIELD, VA- VCDL, Virginia Citizens Defense League, released their legislative scorecards for all Virginia General Assembly Legislators. Senator Amanda Chase received a perfect 100 percent score for the 8th year in a row for a perfect lifetime 2A voting record.

She also received special recognition for carrying 2 Senate bills that would reverse un-American red flag laws passed in 2020 that allow the government to confiscate guns with no due process and a bill that would prohibit localities from creating gun free zones that force law abiding citizens to disarm.

"To me the 2nd Amendment is personal. You have my word that I will never vote for any legislation that would restrict a law abiding citizen's basic fundamental, God-given right to carry for personal protection. I have a solid lifetime 8 year voting record to prove it. Action and history are indicative of future voting. " stated Senator Chase.

All 3 Senate District 12 Candidates claim to support the 2nd Amendment, but Senator Amanda Chase is the only candidate running who has an 8 year voting record gun owners can trust.

body:
Everywhere I look, Biden is protecting his friends in China no matter how hard they try to undermine and threaten our nation.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "Putin & Xi") Peter: Instead of worrying about an investment in "climate, environmental justice and conservation," I want Joe Biden and the rest of Washington investing in America's future. And there won't be a be a future if we allow China, Iran and Russia to threaten our military readiness and national security. The more our military fails to meet recruitment goals, the more our adversaries will know that our military won't deter them any longer because diversity training and CRT never scared a highly trained soldier with a rifle in his hands. More to the point, the war over pronouns won't stop the cyber attacks and potential nuclear attacks we face from foreign adversaries. **[Will you help me wake up Washington and keep our country safe? Donate and let's make our nation the world's leading superpower once again!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "Will you help me wake up Washington and keep our country safe? Donate and let’s make our nation the world’s leading superpower once
again!")** Everywhere I look, Biden is protecting his friends in China no matter how hard they try to undermine and threaten our nation. From trade, to TikTok, to their threats to our manufacturing and investments in technology, to their military prowess. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "Tweet")**How many warnings do you need?** Now China's President is meeting with Vladimir Putin and helping him perpetuate his threats to Ukraine, our country and anyone who opposes his tyranny. When I entered the Marine Corps for my 40+ year career, we emphasized marksmanship and survival over political correctness and that caused everyone to remain in awe of our Armed Forces. **[Join the Bergman Brigade and let's force Biden to remove DEI and pronoun training from our ranks! Donate TODAY!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "Join the Bergman Brigade and let’s force Biden to remove
DEI and pronoun training from our ranks! Donate TODAY!")** Biden is the same man who allowed a Chinese spy balloon to fly over our country undeterred and requested your taxpayer dollars be used to fund gender transitions in our military. His Administration has refused to stop spies from running around Capitol Hill who were posing as reporters. He's back peddled on the nuclear deal with Iran and reversed President Trump's action that hold them accountable. And no matter how he claims to be handling Putin, the war in the Ukraine is well into its second year. We cannot allow our military to be a second-class military power because someone thinks acceptance of drag queens and diversity training will somehow strengthen military recruitment and military readiness. **[Help me show Biden what protecting of our nation should looks like!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "Help me show Biden what protecting of our nation should looks like!")** Our enemies don't prioritize pronouns over military readiness, and neither should the United States. We must Save America first if we want to save our children and our planet. **[If you agree, then join me!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62502349:JPauKXGiN:m:1:3365131770:93F1ACBEFF3AFB10775EDED753D7A3B5:r "If you agree, then join me!")** For our safety,
Rep. Jack Bergman (MI-1)

body:
Friends –
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to our campaign. I hope you’ll give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.
Here is the truth: today we close the books on our first, full FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign.
Shortly after, we’re legally required to report publicly how much money we’ve raised and how many contributions our campaign has received.
And right now, we’re a bit short of where we need to be to hit our goals. That’s important, because reports indicate Senator Sinema is ramping up her fundraising.
Now, we raise our money differently than Senator Sinema. I don’t go around begging hedge fund managers for money.
Instead, almost all of our donations come from people chipping in what they can afford, mostly in response to emails like this one. I’m very proud of that fact.
But it also means from time to time, we have to ask and with our deadline just a few hours away, today is one of those days.
Can you please split a $20 contribution between Serve America and our campaign ahead of our critical FEC fundraising deadline? Help us close the gap so we don’t come up short. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
The strength of our campaign is the people who power our movement. Everyone is going to be looking to see what numbers we report, so your contribution means a lot to our efforts.
Thank you in advance for chipping in today.
Ruben

Friend -- Virginia is at a crossroads. While Glenn Youngkin and Jason Miyares force their radical, far-right agenda on our Commonwealth, Democrats are defending the rights of every day Virginians and preparing to fight back. Service is in my blood, and that's why I started Meet Our Moment, with the aim to create a pipeline for minority candidates who are prepared to run for state and local offices across the Commonwealth by providing them with the necessary resources and tools to run effective campaigns and win. [**Join me in our fight today by contributing $25 or whatever you can to Meet Our Moment before our end of quarter deadline tonight at midnight so we can get Virginia back on track.**](https://act.myngp.com/el/Bf6VvK7sAQtLDmdMuwi_Z_W1LSgcSEafb0lGi1fg65w=/Ee_bNhVKKcBBQGf42D4M5JyEYZEYM3TfK4Ez-JekRZ8=) To date, we've trained 50 Virginians from every corner of the Commonwealth, and nearly 20 Meet Our Moment alumni have either run for office in 2022 or are running in 2023. State and local offices have an outsized impact on our daily lives, and it is critical that our public officials reflect the ever-increasing diversity of Virginia as we enter this new Virginia decade. It's time for us to meet our moment and create the change we seek by rolling up our sleeves and growing the bench of diverse candidates to run for and win offices around Virginia. body:
| | |
---
| | Friends, We have a rapidly approaching fundraising deadline, and I need your support! My election victory in 2021 was one of the closest in the Commonwealth, with only 112 votes separating me from my opponent. Winning my race gave Republicans 51 seats in the House of Delegates – the majority! Every dollar was critical to helping me win. Now I am running for re-election to the House of Delegates and again, my election WILL determine the majority in Richmond. Working with my Republican colleagues as the majority party, we voted to improve our schools, make our communities safer, lower taxes and make our economy more prosperous. Education: Republicans worked together to put parents back at the center of their children’s education and promoted legislation that ensures children in Virginia receive the best education. I introduced Fairness in Women’s Sports, a bill to prohibit biological boys/men from competing in the girls/women categories in our schools. Public Safety: Our legislation this year included efforts to keep some of the dangerous felons from early release, give our local law enforcement agencies more tools to get dangerous criminals off the street, and keep those who commit multiple crimes of violence with firearms behind bars longer. Economy: The House supported changes to our corporate tax structure which would have provided much needed relief to small businesses across the Commonwealth. Inflation has impacted all our citizens, and we worked to keep more money in Virginians’ pockets by reducing the individual income tax and finally getting sales tax off food. I am so glad I won the 51st seat which gave the House a Republican majority, but I also enjoyed my own successes this year. Just this week the Governor signed three of my bills into law! I was honored to be chosen to represent Virginia Beach, and I am working hard to help my constituents and make the best decisions for the Commonwealth. We are currently close to our fundraising goal for the quarter, but we need your help! I am humbly asking for you to chip in and help defend this seat! Your contribution of $51 will allow me to be to remain as the 51st vote in Richmond. Will you help us reach our fundraising goal! Thank you for your support, Karen Greenhalgh

Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

| This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=292b7434bffc4c74a340538ce3ed715f&_e=_T5u4IKqWeqgSnKOf4rNJV79N3sEy0mJSd9v1M9kpp75qkG4J6UFzXBsX8rIF3x6A9jnacNXxKGkUuqCLnVVojzZ6_uZZnChlUXIeJKdOWN6TWQPSioRGPKiMOmG9Fk8gz_izPIF_fGVBJizwL__kZ57aoI4NHSZBfn04dcojPolurPW9JLsp2-oqVnBEs-O1vouMxf2xCOyhqC5St3UGMoUR-ay2BlNvDCnLauH_NQjH7cSBNk-p3bWGZAOiS4zhATC9RfEb-MBpB02zH4L0SwmtZhZwoGm83N6YZ730yx-Y-0E-sTxHH3cAKYNtiWZIX8DhqtWYfR1U7aFFv1BENeV9joX_4gGW_brrHtJYWQAEzDB_GrZvvuYb7zfYNXwMHZ04FDGK0W4mokvAqX_Kw%3D%3D)
---
| |
Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=292b7434bffc4c74a340538ce3ed715f&_e=_T5u4IKqWeqgSnKOf4rNJV79N3sEy0mJSd9v1M9kpp75qkG4J6UFzXBsX8rIF3x6A9jnacNXxKGkUuqCLnVVojzZ6_uZZnChlUXIeJKdOWN6TWQPSioRGPKiMOmG9Fk8gz_izPIF_fGVBJizwL__kZ57aoI4NHSZBfn04dcojPolurPW9JLsp2-oqVnBEs-O1vouMxf2xCOyhqC5St3UGMoUR-ay2BlNvDCnLauH_NTGaLljY4f1Hq8sS8F5_Gdzh87bmPOaeR16FN9hENuxLU0FK17fEw09QU5U6BpcVGWakCI4M6rwWeXcFYMqZzlwFm_caeUyo7paC7jcx-wSvOx9wd7QGkuj24ZJL9vznMWwVAtvbGmxRveTn2viWvtpimc_sD6AFqORn9NBFdTGKg%3D%3D)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=292b7434bffc4c74a340538ce3ed715f&_e=_T5u4IKqWeqgSnKOf4rNJV79N3sEy0mJSd9v1M9kpp75qkG4J6UFzXBsX8rIF3x6A9jnacNXxKGkUuqCLnVVojzZ6_uZZnChlUXIeJKdOWN6TWQPSioRGPKiMOmG9Fk8gz_izPIF_fGVBJizwL__kZ57aoI4NHSZBfn04dcojPolurPW9JLsp2-oqVnBEs-O1vouMxf2xCOyhqC5St3UGMoUR-ay2BlNvDCnLauH_NRJ-8BOMqTVMw29cI6bpHK2Ufp4nlizlbjWMsJp1AEG_MnNsZIlI67KxdfJAqdYz_f_RsnEMsZWVp3wLOb2JsJo6k9s-f8-eEeaiRU9CHdGXB_JbH5DTqsFzX2oB06ekRUwBT7A5ttcLew1dW5IsOckAKYjjMxLSMRi7AowsdE-eA%3D%3D)**

body:
Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dfdca95ec87849bc82e6d8d91d545735&_e=70tKSZf-BqSUIlLosMmbUdLr17JMvC4gGK4u2AvLQgLTE_OqXyiBjHgD36ym98trlLe6yBajef3KhZvLDNQbVzrMEHoOiyVGdhZvzCUBO4hOx9TEMrSIP9xn6n3L_6UnkQa6UYHgKMw2JgPSz2EAFB0QyswYPtvmrbQKygkJuq5u4o_-ywVvUGc6E-KMWIwSnLBnN1Hv2y2G_fZb51wLB7V5s5N1sNlNW-EeI9ZC7mY_qCtXm7PycWd53cm7A__4LlhlfnGzogoppBf0db1Zgg%3D%3D)

Friend,

Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

**They sing the national anthem.**

And they have sung this song proudly every night for _more than 700 straight nights_. This song is more than just a sign of their patriotism. It's an exercise in their freedom of speech, even from the depths of the D.C. gulag.

We captured that audio and had the greatest President, Donald J. Trump, recite the Pledge of Allegiance. Then we combined those recordings to create a song you need to hear. All net proceeds from the song go to certain Jan 6 families in need.

**The song, Justice for All, is number 1 on the Billboard Digital Charts!**

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dfdca95ec87849bc82e6d8d91d545735&_e=70tKSZf-BqSUIlLosMmbUdLr17JMvC4gGK4u2AvLQgLTE_OqXyiBjHgD36ym98trlLe6yBajef3KhZvLDNQbVzrMEHoOiyVGdhZvzCUBO4hOx9TEMrSIP9xn6n3L_6UnRyaPfUeJgH9dBuFwhybpKf2rvW4f9c6OnyT-tf1tMBrLyKH9lNOs6sJSw7TrerSHe-3XQk0LztsR6WK8sQXILzRuEryXe5gLLJPVVTAuVpnQKLfHtDIU_7TX5z5G8PdK-vnVPG8enHJIHv7ZGnsiOQ%3D%3D)

[_**Please listen to this song and support our efforts to provide legal resources to some Jan 6 families. **_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dfdca95ec87849bc82e6d8d91d545735&_e=70tKSZf-BqSUIlLosMmbUdLr17JMvC4gGK4u2AvLQgLTE_OqXyiBjHgD36ym98trlLe6yBajef3KhZvLDNQbVzrMEHoOiyVGdhZvzCUBO4hOx9TEMrSIP9xn6n3L_6UnYyTA0A70D7tj01dtfX7_H6e3hNmvKshXwn_EZiDkD-zdxeV6BSJKHYCHV9Dch09ozm9pld6LeCdjVC73-XWbfhK0QAAMqcJ-B40kVjfEY4eYZeYHMnRRI6Ukk5T-XwVgwqnnPakrAO0UVwNI5aJ1mA%3D%3D)

We all know the plight of the Jan 6th detainees and their families. Due process has been destroyed for so many of them.

But, with your help, I know we will get justice for them.

Instead of violence, we saw many patriots standing around, talking to police officers, and taking photos of the Capitol grounds. There was no _" deadly insurrection."_ **The video evidence proves it for many!** This is evidence they and their families could have used last year or the year before.

It's time to act and help to support these families.

My goal is to reach 1,000 new donors in the next 48 hours to fund their legal battles in court. **Will you stand up and help Jan 6 families?**

Friend,

Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

**They sing the national anthem.**

And they have sung this song proudly every night for _more than 700 straight nights_. This song is more than just a sign of their patriotism. It's an exercise in their freedom of speech, even from the depths of the D.C. gulag.

We captured that audio and had the greatest President, Donald J. Trump, recite the Pledge of Allegiance. Then we combined those recordings to create a song you need to hear. All net proceeds from the song go to certain Jan 6 families in need.

**The song, Justice for All, is number 1 on the Billboard Digital Charts!**

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T72b41008-3039-4f15-939c-6ff9680f54ce/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | Peter, Trump Has Been Indicted _Trump Has Been Indicted_ **Trump Has Been Indicted** **_Trump Has Been Indicted!!_** And, in case you haven't heard: TRUMP HAS BEEN INDICTED **Yes, this is cause for celebration. Not because of how much we detest the living embodiment of the seven deadly sins (+ others he's invented). Yet, because, with his assault on our democratic government and rule of law, it proves our justice system still can work. For everyone. Even a former "President."** [**_So, will you join us in splitting a donation of $2, $5, $25 or whatever you can RIGHT NOW to Joe Biden's reelection campaign and Blue Amp Action, to end the authoritarian menace at the polls in 2024?_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T21c63e42-1ab3-4cb6-8a94-d1967424a2f7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Global factory farms DESTROYING ecosystems
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698537?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Stop taxpayer dollars from supporting giant agribusiness corporations that fuel factory farms expansion! [Act now!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698538?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** **The Brazilian Cerrado is the world’s largest tropical savanna, home to over 80 Indigenous groups and 5% of the world’s plants and animals.** The Indigenous and traditional communities living here have sustained their livelihoods for generations through a relationship to the land and water based upon stewardship and balance. Yet, many communities report facing land grabbing, violence, and intimidation threats by local land owners who sell feed crops to these big companies **for factory farms.** Despite these egregious human rights abuses, **the World Bank is using MILLIONS of our taxpayer dollars to help agribusiness corporations prop up this unsustainable and unjust model of agricultural production,** allowing them to greenwash their destructive activities. **[We need 87 more people from your city to stand up to greedy companies that are fueling the destruction of communities and critical ecosystems! Please, Friend, add your name by 11:59pm TONIGHT!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698539?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** | [Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698540?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Not only do local communities face land grabbing, violence, and other threats -- pesticide-intensive feed crop production pollutes their rivers, depletes their soils, and endangers human health. **What's more, factory farming and the destruction of ecosystems like the Cerrado are key drivers of the climate and biodiversity crises. **
The World Bank must end its support for corporations involved in furthering this destructive model of agriculture before more land is stolen and exploited! **You can help PROTECT HUMAN RIGHTS and END TAXPAYER SUPPORT for giant agribusiness companies! [Friend, tell the World Bank to STOP funding this destructive industry before 11:59pm TONIGHT!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698541?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1698540?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Ashley Schaeffer Yildiz
Senior agriculture and climate finance campaigner,
Friends of the Earth**

# What a Glorious Feeling...
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010WWO9GdudEVzOipuKUpJW1bbn1h7DKRQg-D3yRLL-_WKwUHA-UQflEebLetVyykJl9MAN5IEcFzC54MypB45ypvPVjn9Sx7UhjyZCS-RLt-1Q5MwRWLYRipgGheqKTRBlUWVvlTzc3DEL1PrO1PsmA==&c=bkLmMFnzkFl561gL02KD_2TH2dkGaN87GnVxgL3RDPEoa860uV2ptg==&ch=EqTjSWSLRnnc4WeYpx9dgFWTGOPLiE7ah-ASgV3n-s5eGac3DkiMQg==)

| 'Karen and Jay share thoughts on the virtues of finding sunshine even, and especially, when faced with a rainy day.'
---
| Click here to enjoy the song: 'Singin' in the Rain' (including the goodnight kiss): [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D1ZYhVpdXbQ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010WWO9GdudEVzOipuKUpJW1bbn1h7DKRQg-D3yRLL-_WKwUHA-UQflEebLetVyykJ8ZMbJ2apfPaMNAHksiloiRNwAkoNXtqhMvLDsR_Q3CMEfQsMy27AlGsmHuN079Pc0hHLPMhmKqJ6PozmrFevuKCAs2_zC4HmaV2CVbdbCpNXlO8VY6keQg==&c=bkLmMFnzkFl561gL02KD_2TH2dkGaN87GnVxgL3RDPEoa860uV2ptg==&ch=EqTjSWSLRnnc4WeYpx9dgFWTGOPLiE7ah-ASgV3n-s5eGac3DkiMQg==)
Have you ever had to face a rainy day - and all of a sudden something comes over you? A feeling of joy and excitement. A determination that you're just not going to let that rainy day get the best of you? Something down deep gives you the confidence that you're in charge. You can make your own kind of weather. You can overcome what's happening 'outside,' by what you have the power to make happen on the 'inside.' That is, what you can do with your mind, your spirit, and your imagination. You can bring sunshine and optimism to a rainy day. Both figuratively and literally.
Well, there's a scene from a movie that captures this feeling so perfectly. You may recall the 1950's classic 'Singin' in the Rain' when Gene Kelly's character Don Lockwood famously jumps onto a light post, umbrella in hand while getting absolutely drenched by a rainstorm but without a care in the world. If you read the script, the scene is only described in six words, "Don dances in the wet street". Yet Gene Kelly's performance extends for more than four minutes and has famously come to symbolize that even when we might get rained on in life, no matter the circumstance, there's still much we can both be grateful for and look forward to (like being dry for example).
It's fair to say that we all have those days when we wake up and it just feels nothing is going our way, where even the smallest things can lead you to feeling like you've been dealt a bad hand, the metaphorical 'rainy day'. Life however is very much like the weather, there will be rainy days, snowy days, cloudy days, and sunny days. And, as we saw in 'Singin' in the Rain,' rain is used as a tool in the beginning to demonstrate that Don is experiencing sadness, while at the end, the rain is bringing renewal and new beginnings. So, while every day won't be sunshine and rainbows, how we take the good and the bad and choose to act on them is what makes all the difference.
Sometimes our emotions can get the best of us. Let's face it, they're incredibly powerful and like the weather, can sometimes be impossible to alter. Yet I'm reminded of the phrase 'April showers bring May flowers' in this case meaning that without the rain, we don't get the beauty that it has the potential to bring. Similarly in our own lives, it's important to remember that when we're feeling down or at a low point, it's often those times when we learn and grow the most. So, in short, if you can embrace the rainy days like you might welcome a sunny day, with a full heart and as an opportunity to learn or grow, you too might just find yourself 'Singin' in the Rain!'

| Positive Profile of the Week: Al Kaprielian - the Ultimate All-Weather Man!
---
| | |
---|---
|
This week we are delighted to highlight a true Granite State legend. A man who has educated, informed and entertained us with his meteorological and performance genius - weatherman extraordinaire, Al Kaprielian.

The wild New Hampshire weather patterns, with sudden and extreme changes, is often cursed. However, it is hard to deny the excitement of a good old fashioned Nor'easter snowstorm, or a strong line of thunderstorms rolling in on a warm July late afternoon. Al Kaprielian, the veteran weatherman is well known throughout the Granite State for his unmatched energy and enthusiasm during his on-air segments. He has truly leaned into some of his own highly engaging and sometimes a bit eccentric personality traits and has brought a unique style to broadcasting weather that has made him a beloved staple of New Hampshire news.

With his nearly patented high-pitched description of "hiiigh pressure," and his jovial on-air presentation that often has included quick and sudden movements, and even once displayed jumping jacks during a broadcast, Al Kaprielian has made the weather segment interesting and has made people smile. He has become truly famous here in 'Live Free or Die' country and even landed in the lyrics of a Jay-Z parody New Hampshire rap song that has over 2 million views on YouTube. Over the course of his career, he has also been awarded the title of Best Weather Forecaster, Best Media Personality, and Best Weatherperson by various news and media publications.

"As far back as elementary school, I knew I wanted to be a weatherman," Al expressed, in a recent conversation with one of our Sunshine Initiative teammates. He fondly remembered his first job opportunity as a weatherman back on Labor Day of 1983. And now, with 30 years of teaching, observing, and broadcasting weather, he is still engaged in his passion, recently starting a part-time position with a media outlet in Lowell, Massachusetts. He highlighted a sentiment that runs as a deep and consistent truth here in New Hampshire; authenticity will always remain a beautiful and respected commodity. "My passion and enthusiasm for the weather was always sincere, and I think people recognized that" he stated. "Severe summer weather, snowstorms, hot weather for the beach, you name it, I loved reporting on it."

In an age where so many people often overwork themselves to fit-in and conform, maybe we all can take a lesson from Al Kaprielian. He has pursued his passion with an "all-in" spirit and has courageously opened-up and let New Hampshire viewers see his genuine excitement for all things weather. Al is currently a resident of historic Merrimack, NH, and a graduate of Lyndon State College in Vermont. Despite his statewide stardom over the years, he has often found time in his schedule to visit local schools to teach students about science and meteorology. He continues to mentor young aspiring weather forecasters today. Al Kaprielian is arguably a New Hampshire weather legend, whose positive enthusiasm and unabashed excitement for changes in the atmosphere will not soon be forgotten! Thank you, Al, for all that you contribute to our great Granite State!

A feeling of joy and excitement. A determination that you're just not going to let that rainy day get the best of you? Something down deep gives you the confidence that you're in charge. You can make your own kind of weather. You can overcome what's happening 'outside,' by what you have the power to make happen on the 'inside.' That is, what you can do with your mind, your spirit, and your imagination. You can bring sunshine and optimism to a rainy day. Both figuratively and literally. Well, there's a scene from a movie that captures this feeling so perfectly. You may recall the 1950's classic 'Singin' in the Rain' when Gene Kelly's character Don Lockwood famously jumps onto a light post, umbrella in hand while getting absolutely drenched by a rainstorm but without a care in the world. If you read the script, the scene is only described in six words, "Don dances in the wet street". Yet Gene Kelly's performance extends for more than four minutes and has famously come to symbolize that even when we might get rained on in life, no matter the circumstance, there's still much we can both be grateful for and look forward to (like being dry for example). It's fair to say that we all have those days when we wake up and it just feels nothing is going our way, where even the smallest things can lead you to feeling like you've been dealt a bad hand, the metaphorical 'rainy day'. Life however is very much like the weather, there will be rainy days, snowy days, cloudy days, and sunny days. And, as we saw in 'Singin' in the Rain,' rain is used as a tool in the beginning to demonstrate that Don is experiencing sadness, while at the end, the rain is bringing renewal and new beginnings. So, while every day won't be sunshine and rainbows, how we take the good and the bad and choose to act on them is what makes all the difference. Sometimes our emotions can get the best of us. Let's face it, they're incredibly powerful and like the weather, can sometimes be impossible to alter. Yet I'm reminded of the phrase 'April showers bring May flowers' in this case meaning that without the rain, we don't get the beauty that it has the potential to bring. Similarly in our own lives, it's important to remember that when we're feeling down or at a low point, it's often those times when we learn and grow the most. So, in short, if you can embrace the rainy days like you might welcome a sunny day, with a full heart and as an opportunity to learn or grow, you too might just find yourself 'Singin' in the Rain!' | | == | | Singin' in the Rain - The Story Behind the Movie and Song | == | The Old Farmers' Almanac - The Ultimate All-Weather Guide! | == | | Positive Profile of the Week: Al Kaprielian - the Ultimate All-Weather Man! | | | ---|--- | This week we are delighted to highlight a true Granite State legend. A man who has educated, informed and entertained us with his meteorological and performance genius - weatherman extraordinaire, Al Kaprielian. The wild New Hampshire weather patterns, with sudden and extreme changes, is often cursed. However, it is hard to deny the excitement of a good old fashioned Nor'easter snowstorm, or a strong line of thunderstorms rolling in on a warm July late afternoon. Al Kaprielian, the veteran weatherman is well known throughout the Granite State for his unmatched energy and enthusiasm during his on-air segments. He has truly leaned into some of his own highly engaging and sometimes a bit eccentric personality traits and has brought a unique style to broadcasting weather that has made him a beloved staple of New Hampshire news. With his nearly patented high-pitched description of "hiiigh pressure," and his jovial on-air presentation that often has included quick and sudden movements, and even once displayed jumping jacks during a broadcast, Al Kaprielian has made the weather segment interesting and has made people smile. He has become truly famous here in 'Live Free or Die' country and even landed in the lyrics of a Jay-Z parody New Hampshire rap song that has over 2 million views on YouTube. Over the course of his career, he has also been awarded the title of Best Weather Forecaster, Best Media Personality, and Best Weatherperson by various news and media publications. "As far back as elementary school, I knew I wanted to be a weatherman," Al expressed, in a recent conversation with one of our Sunshine Initiative teammates. He fondly remembered his first job opportunity as a weatherman back on Labor Day of 1983. And now, with 30 years of teaching, observing, and broadcasting weather, he is still engaged in his passion, recently starting a part-time position with a media outlet in Lowell, Massachusetts. He highlighted a sentiment that runs as a deep and consistent truth here in New Hampshire; authenticity will always remain a beautiful and respected commodity. "My passion and enthusiasm for the weather was always sincere, and I think people recognized that" he stated. "Severe summer weather, snowstorms, hot weather for the beach, you name it, I loved reporting on it." In an age where so many people often overwork themselves to fit-in and conform, maybe we all can take a lesson from Al Kaprielian. He has pursued his passion with an "all-in" spirit and has courageously opened-up and let New Hampshire viewers see his genuine excitement for all things weather. Al is currently a resident of historic Merrimack, NH, and a graduate of Lyndon State College in Vermont. Despite his statewide stardom over the years, he has often found time in his schedule to visit local schools to teach students about science and meteorology. He continues to mentor young aspiring weather forecasters today. Al Kaprielian is arguably a New Hampshire weather legend, whose positive enthusiasm and unabashed excitement for changes in the atmosphere will not soon be forgotten! Thank you, Al, for all that you contribute to our great Granite State! | | Quote of the Week | "Life is not about waiting for the storm to pass, it's about learning how to dance in the rain." \- Vivian Greene | Jay Lucas | == | | == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- | | | | | | | Jay Lucas | 7 Portwalk Pl, Portsmouth, NH 03801 | | == Sent by mailto:info@jaylucas.us

| | Peter – I’m running for re-election, and I need to ask for your support. Please give me a chance to explain why your contribution today is so important. One of our biggest strategic imperatives right now is to show that our campaign has significant grassroots support. We don’t want to leave any room for Senate Republicans or the gun lobby to think that I’m vulnerable and put this seat in play for 2024. That’s why we’re trying to post a big number right at the start of this campaign. And I really try to raise money the right way — 100% from people. I also limit my time at fundraising events and don’t spend all day calling billionaires to fund my campaign. My job is to focus on the work you elected me to do. Instead, my campaign relies on lots and lots of grassroots donations from people like you. Every Senate campaign is expensive. There’s no way around it, but doing this the right way makes elected officials and our party more responsive to the people. If you are with me and agree that this is the way we should run our campaigns, **[then please consider making a split donation of whatever you can afford to my re-election and Patty Murray. body:
Over the past few months, I have had the pleasure of speaking with 1000s of voters about the issues most important to them. | | | |
---
| | | Dear ,
---
| [ ](https://quillforvirginia.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4748996a05a433fd69cc0588e&id=3147676d56&e=8787be5d90)
---
|
---
| With this quarter fastly coming to a close, I thought I would share with you what Team Quill has learned on the campaign trail. Over the past few months, I have had the pleasure of speaking with 1000s of voters about the issues most important to them.

**Time and time again, I hear stories of people deciding between filling up their gas tank or grocery cart...**

Of people furious with the nonsense occurring in our schools...

And of people against overdevelopment and the fundamental changes that data centers will bring to our county...

However, they are worried that sending another career politician down to Richmond will lead to the same status quo. **But I'm not a career politician; I'm a father, a husband, and a veteran running to ensure my children have the same opportunity to achieve the American Dream that I had. **

I'm not doing this to add another notch to my belt, another job title, or to enrich myself. In fact, I announced that I would be donating my salary when elected to some incredible organizations in the district: Moms for Liberty, Willing Warriors, and Boxes of Basics.

I chose these organizations specifically because of the tremendous work that they do. The services and support they provide to the community are truly inspiring and life-changing.

Here in Prince William County, I really do believe this is the best place to live in the entire country. The more voters I get to know and the more I hear their stories, the more that belief is affirmed.

That's why I am working so hard to represent you in Richmond; **your voice should be heard in the House of Delegates. **

But I cannot do this alone, and I need your support. Our campaign finance deadline is rapidly approaching at the end of today and I need your help to reach my goal. Quarterly campaign finance reports are an important way to show the strength of this campaign. Any amount you can chip in to help me get my message out is truly appreciated.

**Let's get to work!**

uses a whiteboard to hold corrupt CEOs and incompetent government
officials accountable.

deserve a warrior to fight the battles of tomorrow, stand up to special
interests, and “do Congress” in a way that connects with Americans—many of
whom are disillusioned about whether our government can work for them.

Now we’re just hours out from our end of quarter fundraising deadline. And
look, CEOs and my teenagers can agree: I’m not one for BS answers. So here
are two quick reasons why I’m asking for your $5 right now.

1. This end of quarter deadline will be the first time our Senate
campaign is required to publicly report how much money we have raised
since launching. A strong number signals that I’m a serious competitor
in this race and can prevent super PACs from attacking me (let’s show
them it’s not worth it!).

Friend,

Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

**They sing the national anthem.**

And they have sung this song proudly every night for _more than 700 straight nights_. This song is more than just a sign of their patriotism. It's an exercise in their freedom of speech, even from the depths of the D.C. gulag.

We captured that audio and had the greatest President, Donald J. Trump, recite the Pledge of Allegiance. Then we combined those recordings to create a song you need to hear. All net proceeds from the song go to certain Jan 6 families in need.

**The song, Justice for All, is number 1 on the Billboard Digital Charts!**

Other people want to win this seat, and putting up a weak finance report would signal to opponents that there may be an opening for them to take it. Second, campaigns take a massive amount of resources. Even smaller city council races like mine take thousands of grassroots dollars to be able to pull off. clean_body: Our goals are ambitious, but they're not arbitrary We'll be direct, folks: Our team has set some very ambitious goals ahead of tonight's official FEC fundraising deadline, and when we launched our end-of-quarter push earlier this week, we honestly weren't sure if we were going to reach them or not. But we hit send on our first batch of emails and texts — and so far, our movement has shown up in a big, big way. First it was Frederick, a pilot from Baltimore who chipped in $27. A few seconds later, Nicholas in Winona, MN added $10 of their own. Then it was Carole, a social worker in Colorado with another $20... and we were off to the races. We have a real chance of getting to where we need to be, but only if we have another big day today. We can't afford to slow down — which is why we have to ask: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly. | | ** | | | | | | | As we said, our goals are ambitious, but they're not arbitrary. Every single donation we receive before midnight, no matter how big or small, will go a long way in showing the strength of the movement we're building together. So please: can Ilhan count on you to join Frederick, Nicholas, Carole, and the thousands of grassroots progressives all across the country who have stood with us so far this quarter? subject: Difficult decisions

body:
With the Senate on the line, with the House in reach, our voices can be influential in several races.
#
Derek —
Tonight at midnight, we close the books on our first FEC fundraising deadline of the 2024 campaign.
It might only be 2023, but we’re already laying the groundwork for the next two years. And when this deadline is over we are going to look at the money we’ve raised and then we are going to look at the map of critical races in 2024.
From there, we’re going to have to make some really hard decisions.
Can we afford to run ads in Montana to defend Jon Tester? Are we needed in Pennsylvania, particularly rural Pennsylvania where our messengers resonate? How about Arizona, with all the Veterans and Military families there?
We’ve had a decent start to the year, and we’ve been able to go on the air on Military bases across the country pushing the Pentagon to ban Tucker Carlson, Hannity, and Ingraham from broadcasting on base.
But what we raise before this FEC deadline ends will determine where we can go next. And with the Senate on the line, with the House in reach, our voices can be influential in several races if we can get a head start.
But we can’t do that alone, so please:
**[Can you please make a $3 contribution — or whatever you can afford — before our first FEC fundraising deadline of the 2024 election cycle comes to a close tonight at midnight?**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-mar23.Xt_ByJ&refcode=em230331-1-15&t=1&akid=8130%2E3013755%2EEEusBb)
We WILL use your donation on the races and issues you care about. So thank you in advance for chipping in.
The team at VoteVets

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T726f07d3-f23e-472a-b7dd-00d2f37b89da/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | Peter, Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, 24 states have banned abortion or are likely to do so in the coming months.[1] Hundreds of thousands of Americans seek an abortion every year. Our research found that Google still retains location search queries for reproductive care facilities – despite promising otherwise. This is a HUGE problem: Right-wing state governments are increasingly seeking to prosecute people seeking abortions – and even private citizens can sue anyone who aids and abets abortion seekers in states like Oklahoma or Texas. [2] **[Peter, will you join us in calling on Google to protect users’ privacy and delete users’ location data that state governments and private citizens could use to prosecute those seeking reproductive health care →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td2524d6c-478a-454d-ae20-a3b7310da1eb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

---
| Thanks to previous pressure we put on Google last year, they updated their policy to automatically delete the location data of visits to "particularly personal" locations like counseling centers, domestic violence shelters, abortion clinics, fertility centers, addiction treatment facilities, weight loss clinics, cosmetic surgery clinics, and others.

However, our own research shows that this data is STILL being stored despite Google’s promises, and it could be weaponized by anti-abortion prosecutors and state agents. Reporting from December concluded that location history data related to visiting abortion clinics was stored by Google for months, despite their promises to automatically delete that sensitive data. **[This is unacceptable. Join us in calling on Google to uphold its promise and ADD YOUR NAME to demand Google stop collecting and retaining location data from users.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8f30392c-ccec-4e2b-be8f-c14aa4b22e8d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Thanks for taking action with us to hold Google accountable, – The Team at Accountable Tech [1] Guttmatcher Institute: [https://www.guttmacher.org/2023/01/six-months-post-roe-24-us-states-have-banned-abortion-or-are-likely-do-so-roundup](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf6350622-dd08-4a34-b80f-a54290c8e542/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [2] CNN: [https://www.cnn.com/2022/04/28/politics/oklahoma-heartbeat-act/index.html](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf2011235-dec0-4b4b-bbb2-84aa203108d3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | Friend,

The past two election cycles have made one thing clear: While our values remain strong, our messaging has oftentimes been weak. We are changing this!

Though not everyone becomes a Republican for the same reasons, my wife Janelle and I started Let's Win for America Action (LWFAA) to highlight the fact that we are united through a belief in personal responsibility and a desire to protect our constitutional rights. So regardless of background, we are committed to keeping America on top and ahead.

We can’t do that by being divided. We must share our unique pro-America stories and unify so that our conservative messages are the focus. Ultimately, we want more people to see that the values that sustain our country are conservative values.

But we need your help.

[Will you support our movement with a generous donation of $35, $50, $100, or more today?](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=5cafe498e4&e=cb396c52a2)

For too long, the Left has sold the lie that you are doomed to be less than others because of your skin color, ethnicity, background, or neighborhood. I don't buy that.

My story includes...
\- being born to a teenage mother
\- being raised in a single-parent home
\- overcoming the challenge of poverty

Statistically speaking, I shouldn't have made it. But through hard work, I earned an appointment to the United States Air Force Academy and changed the trajectory of my life. I truly am a product of the American dream, which makes me the fiercest defender of freedom, opportunity, and American exceptionalism.

I've found that the true causes of disparities in America are family stability, problematic patterns of behavior, and cultural priorities. I’m proof that your skin color doesn't matter; you can take your future into your own hands. This is why I am PASSIONATE about bringing a winning conservative message to minority communities who traditionally vote Democrat.

[If you believe this is a critical mission for the future of our party, please consider making a donation.](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=7e7cf14632&e=cb396c52a2)

As a veteran, business owner, father, and former Senate candidate (who happens to be black), I have seen how the Democrats’ policies hurt minority communities. Much of my support came from minority Republicans – folks tired of the Democrats calling them "victims." From business owners to community leaders, my conversations with these people gave me hope for the party's future.

Democrat politicians, race-hustlers, and poverty-pimps push an agenda that separates the individual from the American dream. Now is the time for us to usurp these gatekeepers and go directly to the people with a positive message of hope and economic prosperity.

At LWFAA, we aim to facilitate authentic conversations about real issues directly with minority communities. Only through having tough conversations will we be able to spread the message of solid economics, strengthened families, and limited government to the communities who need these principles to thrive.

Empowering our families, state, and country through conservative principles stood central to my Senate campaign. It's paramount to Janelle and me that the Republican party doesn't lose another seat because of weak messaging. I hope you feel the same.

[With your help, we can continue to spread our message.](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=48c7833c00&e=cb396c52a2)

God Bless,

Co-Chair | Let’s Win for America Action

**Former President Donald Trump was just indicted on charges related to hush-money payments made to Stormy Daniels and another woman on his behalf in the lead-up to the 2016 election.**

This is an outstanding victory for the rule of law and our democracy. No one is above the law, and it’s crucial for our democracy that we keep it that way.

But this is also just the beginning. Trump has a long history of unethical and criminal behavior, and many more charges are likely to come as the investigations continue.

**[Fellow activist, we must remain vigilant in the defense of our democracy as further investigations come in. body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62504546:6_8QfXGNB:m:1:3331421248:354C25DA305F20F85E0E940ECDAD9D02:r)

Peter,

Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

**They sing the national anthem.**

And they have sung this song proudly every night for _more than 700 straight nights_. This song is more than just a sign of their patriotism. It's an exercise in their freedom of speech, even from the depths of the D.C. gulag.

We captured that audio and had the greatest President, Donald J. Trump, recite the Pledge of Allegiance. Then we combined those recordings to create a song you need to hear. All net proceeds from the song go to certain Jan 6 families in need.

**The song, Justice for All, is number 1 on the Billboard Digital Charts!**

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62504546:6_8QfXGNB:m:1:3331421248:354C25DA305F20F85E0E940ECDAD9D02:r)

body:
I’m personally asking you to join my reelection campaign | | | Can I explain something, Peter? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the only U.S. Senator who manages a full-time job outside the Senate — **as a farmer.** Every spring, I spend weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. # _Continuing to Grow the Party_
---
---
Since I became chairman, I've had a passion for growing our party. As I wrote here last week, we have always been the party of freedom, opportunity, and prosperity, and of good policy that brings us closer to those ideals. However, we haven't always been the best at communicating that, nor building the necessary relationships to ensure that our messages reaches as far as it _can_ and _should_. And as our state has continued to grow and become more diverse and more urban, I knew that this had to change in order to ensure our long-term viability. This weekend we reached a big milestone in doing just that. On Saturday, the third cohort of the Indiana Republican Diversity Leadership Series gathered for the first time, and I had the opportunity to speak with them and welcome them to our headquarters in downtown Indianapolis. From our conversations, I can tell that the members of this cohort, like those before, are driven to make a real difference in their communities as some are running for office and others are already involved in their local party. I’m excited to see how they will engage with the program and use it to help them develop into strong leaders. We're the party with a message that resonates with all, and we'll continue to spread that message and take our party to new heights. Enjoy this week's newsletter. Sincerely,
---
---
Chairman Kyle Hupfer

# **Governor Holcomb's Week That Was**
---
| |
# _Taking in Some Hoops and Taking on the Next Step of the I-69 River Crossing Project_
---
---
| | _Last Saturday,**Governor Eric Holcomb** attended the IHSAA boys basketball state championships and had some time to chat with IU men's basketball coach Mike Woodson. Afterwards, Gov. Holcomb tweeted: "Great job [IHSAA] and congratulations to each of the state finals teams who competed!"_
---
This week, the I-69 Ohio River Crossing, a project that has been years in the making, moved one step closer to becoming a reality, after Indiana and Kentucky signed an initial Memorandum of Agreement to begin preliminary development and financial planning for the second phase of the project. “The Crossroads of America is more than a motto for Indiana. It’s a mission,” said **Governor Eric Holcomb**. “That’s why it’s so important to see this generational project progressing forward. Our goal is to improve connectivity for all Hoosiers, and we know strong infrastructure puts us in an even stronger position for economic development and continued successes. Connecting our states will improve the region and make a difference for Hoosiers for decades to come.” You can read more about the announcement of the second phase [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/44716173f30ed023/5161e446ef8df58ec3d6b838967d376c/40313).
---
| | |
---
# _U.S. House Passes H.R. 1, The Lower Energy Costs Act, Includes Provisions from Reps. Pence, Bucshon_
---
Yesterday, the U.S. House passed H.R. 1, the Lower Energy Costs Act, by a vote of 225-204; only 4 Democrats joined Republicans to reverse the disastrous Biden energy agenda and restore America's energy independence. Included in the bill were provisions from **Reps. Greg Pence** and **Larry Bucshon**. H.R. 1140 from **Rep. Pence** would unlock critical energy minerals while H.R. 1060 from **Rep. Bucshon** would strengthen and secure America's critical mineral supply. H.R. 1 would unleash American energy and cut costs for families by:
1. Increasing domestic energy production
2. Reforming the permitting process for all industries
3. Reversing anti-energy policies advanced by President Biden
4. Streamlining energy infrastructure and exports
5. Boosting the production and processing of critical minerals

You can learn more about the bill by clicking [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/44716173f30ed023/80915ee77c383ad8c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

body:
I’ve been told I’m an underdog in this race, and when I hear that I look around the room.
Derek,
I’ve been told I’m an underdog in this race, and when I hear that I look around the room...because I don’t think of myself as an underdog. And I’m not, because I have all of you on our team.
**But I’m not naive to the challenges this race presents. Polling has us just two points behind another candidate, a small and certainly not insurmountable gap.**
A bright spot in that poll is the fact that I’m leading the county I represent in Congress by nine points. **When I’m able to introduce myself to voters, we gain a clear advantage.** That’s why I’m asking for your support to help us ramp up our campaign and get our message out there.
Here’s a personal link you can use:
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kpem-1222?refcode=EMAF31_1_EOQ_20230331_V1_F](https://act.katieporter.com/go/16597?refcode=EMAF31_1_EOQ_20230331_V1_F&t=5&akid=20339%2E3422442%2EYbB7UE)**
Derek, **I don’t “do Congress” like most people do.** I was the only Democrat in the House to oppose “earmarks,” a way of funding Members’ pet projects. I’m leading the fight to ban congressional stock trading, and I’m one of just eleven Members of Congress who doesn't take checks from lobbyists.
My life looks different than most of my colleagues: I’m the only single mom of school aged kids serving in the House, and **I’d be the only one in the Senate.**
California needs a warrior in the Senate to fight the battles of tomorrow—creating an economy that works for everyone, lowering the cost of housing, and fighting for our planet.
**I need you in this fight with me: We have an end of quarter fundraising deadline TONIGHT at midnight.** Reporting a strong number is the first step to winning this race. If you’re with me, chip in here:
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kpem-1222?refcode=EMAF31_1_EOQ_20230331_V1_F](https://act.katieporter.com/go/16597?refcode=EMAF31_1_EOQ_20230331_V1_F&t=6&akid=20339%2E3422442%2EYbB7UE)**
Katie Porter

name: Joe Kent
subject: My greatest weakness (Personal)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Peter,
When I first began my campaign for Congress, I had to do a lot of things I'd never had to do before during the twenty years I spent in the military.
Some of these new things I enjoy a lot, like holding town halls where I can talk to voters about how we have to defeat the woke left that is destroying our country. I also appreciate hearing from people from all different walks of life and from all over my district, sharing their hopes and dreams, fears and concerns.
However, the one thing I really dislike doing, more than anything else, is asking for money. No matter how often I've done it, it still makes me a little uncomfortable.
But I also accept the reality that if we are going to have any chance to flip this seat, I need to raise money - a lot of money.
And today is the last day of the quarter. We have a big report we need to file with the FEC that's a public measure of how successful we have been as a campaign.
So let me please ask you to make one more donation today, for as much as you can afford, at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/5GgbHQC81jTZJjPGWeC1yA/AjLX2GANdB19S0KSURUWHQ).
In my last race, a lot of factors played into the loss but the one overwhelming obstacle was that I was outspent six to one in the General Election. In a congressional district that's only narrowly Republican, it's very hard to overcome an opponent when they can financially overwhelm you that much.
We can't let that happen again.
It's absolutely vital that we flip this seat red in the next election. This district represents the Republican's BEST HOPE of picking up a seat anywhere in the country.
So please give what you can at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/5GgbHQC81jTZJjPGWeC1yA/AjLX2GANdB19S0KSURUWHQ).
I'll keep doing my part: talking to voters, knocking on doors, persuading the people of this district that I'm the best person to go to DC and represent their values, and, yes, raising money.
Please help by doing your part. Make a contribution today and help us have a successful financial report for the first quarter at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/5GgbHQC81jTZJjPGWeC1yA/AjLX2GANdB19S0KSURUWHQ).
Respectfully,
Joe Kent

Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Today is International Trans Day of Visibility
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?refcode=20230331_em_sjj_tdov [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?refcode=20230331_em_sjj_tdov]
My brother, Dylan, is one of the bravest people I know. When he came out as trans, I was so happy he could live as his true, authentic self. But it also breaks my heart that, for trans people everywhere, simply living their lives every day is an act of profound bravery.
Because - despite all the incredible progress we’ve made - the world is still so hostile for trans people. And they can’t fight hostility, transphobia, and bigotry alone. It’s up to all of us to stand in solidarity with our trans siblings - to demand safety, dignity, and respect.
Today is International Transgender Day of Visibility, and I have one important ask of you: Will you stand with me in support of the trans community, against hate and violence? Add your name to be a citizen co-sponsor of my House resolution in support of the trans community on this day of visibility - and every day. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Gr3w9lEQgUev8ARVaF3hOA2]
Today, we honor the lives and incredible achievements of trans people around the world, and celebrate the courage it takes to live authentically. We owe it to our trans siblings to amplify their voices - and we’d also be remiss to ignore the stark, cruel realities they endure every day. While our society has become much more accepting in recent years, hateful and ignorant rhetoric abounds, and too many right-wing political leaders spend their time proposing cruel policy ideas rather than solving problems.
I’m not going to spend this day focusing only on the negatives, but I will say this: People like Donald Trump are leading a mob of hate that intentionally makes life more dangerous for queer and trans kids every single day, and that has real consequences. Last year there was a 12x increase in anti-LGBTQ+ violence. The threats to this community are real, deadly, and growing by the day. A record number of anti-trans bills have been introduced in state legislatures in recent years, including more than 700 bills between 2021 and 2023.
For these reasons and more, we also have to recognize that not everyone wants to be visible, nor does everyone have the resources or support to be their true selves. We need to stand in solidarity with trans people, wherever they are in their journey. That begins with saying proudly:
You are perfect.
You are seen.
I’m sending you love and strength, today and every day.
If you’re with me on this, I hope you’ll add your name to mine and support the transgender community. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Gr3w9lEQgUev8ARVaF3hOA2]
Thank you for your support!
-Sara

name: Ro Khanna
subject: Working Americans: Always. Corporate interests: Never.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
We need all hands on deck to help us reach our end-of-quarter goals.
#
Friend,
Since the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Citizens United_ ruling ended caps on corporate campaign spending over a decade ago, PACs have flooded our elections with obscene amounts of money.
Last year alone, PACs spent $6.5 billion to influence the midterms—more than twice what candidates spent.
Our political process shouldn’t be up for sale. That’s why I founded the No PAC Caucus the moment I got to Washington. I work for working Americans; not special interests.
[**Today is the last day before our fundraising numbers are made public, and we need to show that our grassroots movement is strong. Will you help by donating what you can today?**](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11321?t=6&akid=2674%2E946728%2EhnqO5p)
Getting PAC money out of politics is critical to advancing a progressive agenda—passing Medicare for All, making childcare affordable, reviving U.S. manufacturing—that will help small businesses thrive and working Americans prosper.
Our grassroots movement is powered by folks like you, and your continued support proves that there is a real alternative to funding political campaigns.
[**We need all hands on deck to help us reach our end-of-quarter goals. Each dollar you contribute is vital, allowing us to fight for the American Dream in Congress each and every day.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11321?t=7&akid=2674%2E946728%2EhnqO5p)
Thank you for being by my side every step of the way.
In solidarity,
Ro

| It’s DCCC Chair Congresswoman Suzan DelBene.

I’m reaching out with an urgent request. Earlier this month, I added Sharice Davids to the DCCC’s list of 2024 Frontline Members — a list of incredible incumbent Democrats whose victories are essential to taking back the House majority next November.

body:
Some exciting national + local endorsements!
#
We’re seeing some serious MO-mentum, Peter!
In the months since Lucas Kunce launched his campaign to replace Josh Hawley, national groups + local leaders have lined up to support our grassroots movement.
**FIRST:** After Josh Hawley introduced a fake Social Security bill that didn’t do anything to actually protect the benefits everyday people worked hard to earn, **Social Security Works PAC officially endorsed Lucas Kunce.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/30593?refcode=em20230331-2903&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=2903%2E614464%2EF3WrqZ)
**THEN:** When Hawley tried to use family farmers as campaign props, **former Missouri Lieutenant Governor Joe Maxwell, threw his support behind Lucas.**
After serving as our state’s last Democratic LG, Joe became an influential advocate for defending American farmers from corporate takeover and consolidation — and he knows Lucas will continue that fight in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/30593?refcode=em20230331-2903&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=2903%2E614464%2EF3WrqZ)

body:
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/61040806/399003765/765663662?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTJlZGY1MC1kOWNmLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y0mc8HmqPRyUA8DA15Ni7CHOhNHDiyg08CP-bZGa9PI=&emci=4e3bd559-1fcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=192edf50-d9cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=561582) | Team: Today not only marks the end of the first quarter of 2023, it also brings with it the end date for temporary expanded Medicaid coverage that was granted as a result of the Covid-19 pandemic. Today millions of Americans will lose access to expanded Medicaid coverage because their state officials have refused to enact the more extensive coverage rolled out via the Affordable Care Act (ACA). When the ACA was signed into law, 24 states with extremist state officials refused to roll out the expanded coverage to their citizens. We knew just how serious their inaction was, so since then we’ve worked in 7 different states alongside voters to pass Medicaid expansion and grant them the health care they badly need. But, we're short on our fundraising start-up goals for 2024.
The quarter closes tonight at midnight. Our FEC reports are due soon. I have to ask - In the spirit of holding politicians like Donald Trump accountable, can you make contribution to my campaign for Congress today? [bit.ly/MIRuralFund]

No American is above the law, and like everyone else, he can defend his innocence in court. Justice must work without regard to one's political stature, popularity, wealth, or power.

I genuinely care about every one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected, I will strive to be the voice for all district residents. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality, and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day, we build and strengthen partnerships with voters and citizens alike who align with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. I particularly love meeting and working with the younger generations. They are the voice of the future and are very active and enthusiastic in learning how to be involved.
The United States is divided economically, politically, and culturally more than ever before. So, it's time to unite, and it's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities.
