Our Apps or other services features may rely on this location information to provide certain location-based services, such as our promotional offers, merchandise offers, event information, or other Save America-related content that may be of interest to you. We may also use location information to improve the functionality of our Apps and our other applications and services. If you do not wish to have this location information collected and used by us, you may opt out by disabling the location and Bluetooth features on your device and/or in our Apps. As a general note, you may choose not to provide certain information, but you may not be able to access certain content or take advantage of certain features of the Services.
Depending on your device, we may use third-party services to provide mapping services. For example, we may use Google maps on specific devices. You can learn more about the information that Google collects through its mapping services at google.com/privacy.

The United States is divided economically, politically, and culturally more than ever before. So, it's time to unite, and it's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities. Instead, we’re going to be straightforward about why hitting our fundraising goals, even this far out from the next election, is really important — and we hope that at the end, we’ll have convinced you to **[chip in a few dollars if you’re able](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/61041560/399006180/1342890860?refcode=email_033123_eoq3&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjJiNTNkOS1kYWNmLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HBmEDvmDvrtEXf6nKUi_AmcnaT4YmCp0vWSdWSjWyKg=)**. After tonight’s deadline, our first-quarter fundraising will be made public for anyone to see and scrutinize. If we have a strong showing, it can make Republicans think twice about targeting Brittany. But if we underperform our benchmarks, it will only incentivize more attacks and more negativity from Kevin McCarthy and his allies. **So, no, we aren’t going to tell you that if you don’t chip in $5, all hope is lost. BUT we will be candid that if you’re able to donate a few bucks, it makes our job defending this seat and keeping Colorado blue easier. body:
To our LGBTQIA2S+ family, know you are not alone.
#
Peter,
Today, on Trans Day of Visibility, we celebrate trans joy and redouble our commitments to uplift this community in the face of unrelenting attacks on our trans family.
In January, ACLU data revealed that **Missouri Republicans have proposed more anti-LGBTQIA2S+ legislation than any other state in the country.** It's appalling.
**As a healthcare professional, I know gender-affirming care is health care,** and stand with the leading medical organizations and studies that show it is a medical necessity for our trans youth.
Unfortunately, trans Missourians aren't alone. From Florida, to Indiana, Iowa to Kentucky — to center stage this month at a major conservative event in Washington, DC — the far right are targeting the LGBTQIA2S+ community, especially our trans family members, with vitriol. **The disturbing trend of anti-LGBTQIA2S+ extremism must not go unchecked.**
There is a real life-or-death impact of the Republican's obsessive attacks on the LGBTQIA2S+ community through legislation that attempts to criminalize vulnerable students, parents, health care providers, and members of the trans community.
**And when the GOP couldn't get certain bills passed in Congress, they shifted their focus toward fear-mongering ballot initiatives — seeking to dismantle our rights one state at a time.**

In the fight to end gun violence, we cannot make progress unless we work together.

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar23.q3bw9s&refcode=em230331-1-30&t=1&akid=4847%2E3935704%2EhdAezb)
In the fight to end gun violence, we cannot make progress unless we work together.
Gabby founded our organization ten years ago because when she heard about the shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School, she knew she had to do something, even though she was deep in the process of her own recovery.
We’ve made substantial progress in the fight to end gun violence since our founding, including last year’s landmark federal legislation, but unfortunately the fight is far from over. Children are still being shot in classrooms. We still can’t enter our community spaces—churches, movie theaters, grocery stores—without the fear of gunfire.
And so we must keep moving forward.
Tonight, we’re coming up on our first quarterly fundraising deadline of the year, and we’re hoping we can ask you to make your first online contribution to Giffords PAC today.
It’s not just about the total we raise, but also the amount of individual contributions we receive. Both of these will send a loud and clear message that our movement to keep our communities safe from gun violence is stronger than ever.

Friend,
**Rep. Rashida Tlaib is leading a massive shift in Congress and across the country in support of Palestinian human rights.**
A recent Gallup poll demonstrates this shift, showing that Democrats and Independents increasingly support Palestinians.1 Polls from the past few years have also shown that most Americans and a significant majority of Democrats support conditioning U.S. military aid to Israel on whether Israel complies with human rights law.
**As the only Palestinian-American member of Congress, Rashida is working to end the unjust status quo that treats Palestinians as less than human.**
Her Congressional leadership includes introducing a resolution to recognize the Nakba (“catastrophe” in Arabic), when over 750,000 Palestinians were murdered and displaced as part of the creation of the state of Israel. She continues to call on President Biden and the State Department to act, including to:
* Condition U.S. military aid to Israel on ending the Israeli military’s human rights abuses
* Investigate Israeli soldiers’ assassination of beloved Palestinian-American journalist Shireen Abu Akleh
* End plans to build the U.S. embassy in Jerusalem, and to not build the embassy on land stolen from Palestinians
* Demand that Israel end its discriminatory treatment of Palestinian Americans and other U.S. citizens with Arab or Muslim heritage (which Rashida has also faced)

**Rashida is changing the conversation about what it means to stand up for human rights for all, with no exceptions. But as Republicans and Democrats in Congress try to silence legitimate criticism of Israel, Rashida’s bold voice and leadership are more critical now than ever.**

A Manhattan grand jury indicted Donald Trump yesterday, friends. This is the first time in U.S. history that a president — current or former — has faced criminal charges. I know some are celebrating this. But I believe it's more important than ever to take a step back and let this process play out. Trump refers to himself as the "law and order" president, while also spending years eroding trust in our institutions and our justice system. Now, Trump is calling for his supporters to take to the streets and protest. Again. Despite Trump’s efforts, this indictment is a poignant reminder that our justice system remains intact and that no one — including a former president — is above the law. It’s also important to remember that chaos and attention is what Trump wants. He revels in it, and celebrating his potential demise only feeds his narrative. The time for Trump to be held accountable under the law is drawing near. Let's not give him the audience he so desperately craves. Instead, let’s be patient — to ensure he gets what he deserves. — Martin

# Happy Trans Day of Visibility!

Today, we celebrate the International Trans Day of Visibility. This Friday, we recognize the joy and resilience of trans and non-binary people everywhere by elevating their voices and experiences.

To celebrate, the DNC will be hosting a panel with key stakeholders on the importance of **uplifting the trans and non-binary community, taking place on****[Friday, March 31, at 5 p.m. ET](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=05250035b0&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**. We are excited to have DNC Chair Jaime Harrison join us for this call, as well as movement leaders Charlotte Clymer, Josie Caballero, Vivian Topping, Evan Minton, and Marisa Richmond.

---
| [RSVP HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e9db2d8832&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP HERE")
---
| | [THE DNC'S JOINT STATEMENT ON THE TRANS DAY OF VISIBILITY](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=3e442f6d93&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
| _DNC Chair Jaime Harrison, DNC LGBTQ Caucus Chair Earl Fowlkes, and the National Center for Transgender Equality Action Fund released the[following statement on Transgender Day of Visibility](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=de122ba5de&e=d6c5c7d7ec):_ “Today, we reaffirm our commitment to transgender and non-binary Americans and celebrate the many contributions they make to our country. From the arts to activism, to our armed forces and the highest levels of government, transgender and non-binary people are valued members of society and play an essential role in pushing our nation closer toward progress. “Instead of focusing on protecting and delivering for all Americans, extremist Republicans across the country are fixated on targeting transgender people and their families, determined to strip away their rights and freedoms that all Americans deserve. These extremists are using the transgender community as political pawns. This year we have already seen state legislatures across the country introduce anti-LGBTQ legislation, and the Republican House majority has proposed similar extreme legislation that would target transgender and LGBTQ youth rather than addressing the actual issues facing students today. Certain Republicans have even gone as far as calling for the eradication of all trans people. “While many Republicans continue to double down on their extremism, which directly conflicts with our nation’s values of freedom and bodily autonomy, Democrats across the country are standing up and fighting back. As Democrats, we believe there is no asterisk over the word freedom. We believe that health care is a right for all, including the right to access gender affirming care. We believe that our communities should be safe and welcoming to all, including members of the transgender and nonbinary community. We believe that trans rights are human rights and we will work tirelessly to ensure they are protected.”

Fellow Patriot: Former House Speaker John Boehner once famously compared his Republican opponents to "political terrorists." In January, when House Freedom Caucus members held up Kevin McCarthy's vote to become Speaker, Rep. Dan Crenshaw went on Fox Radio and said, "we cannot let the terrorists win." subject: A big day for Kentucky’s future
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ANDY BESHEAR FOR GOVERNOR
body:
I’ve just signed two huge bills into law. Peter,

Today is a big day for Kentucky’s future. I have just signed into law two of the biggest legislative priorities of my first term: legalizing medical cannabis and sports betting. Both of these laws are policies that Kentuckians have supported for years and years, and thanks to the hard work of my administration, we have delivered results for our Commonwealth.

I'm proud of the work my administration has done in the last three years to create lasting change for millions of Kentuckians. We've created tens of thousands of good-paying jobs, made historic investments to support Kentucky’s economy, and expanded affordable healthcare access. And now, people who deserve relief will have legal access to medical cannabis, and with the legalization of sports betting we will stop seeing millions of dollars in revenue leave the borders of our state each year. **This is real progress for our state and our people.**

**But we've still got plenty of work to do.** Tonight at midnight is the first official fundraising deadline of 2023. That means all the candidates' fundraising numbers will be reported and made available to the public soon. My 12 Republican opponents will be looking closely to try to spot any vulnerabilities, so we need to ensure we can show them the strength of this grassroots team.

That's why I need your support right now. **Please, if you're able before midnight, donate to my re-election and help me keep fighting for Kentuckians. body:
Did you get a chance to read the email below?

Our end-of-month deadline is MIDNIGHT, and we need your help to meet our monthly fundraising goal.**Unfortunately, we 're still $650 away. **

Democrats are at it again! They are prioritizing their biggest campaign donors over taxpayers. And their latest $70 billion spending spree proves it.

We can hold them accountable. But that requires media outlets like Shift WA to shine a light on what's happening in Olympia.
** **
**Unfortunately, you cannot count on the mainstream media to expose the Democrats ' real priorities - but you can count on us.**

Our efforts depend entirely on the generous contributions of grassroots supporters like you. [**Will you help us ensure voters are informed about what 's going on in Olympia by making an end-of-month contribution of $100, $50, or even $25 today?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657914:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r)

**[Please, consider contributing by MIDNIGHT tonight.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657914:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r)**

Thank you,

The Shift WA team
The biggest beneficiaries of the Democrats' record-breaking spending spree are the state employee and public sector unions which will receive hefty pay raises - and then the unions will put big money back into Democrat campaign accounts. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657915:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends,

You've seen the headlines, and the real story is even worse. Democrats in Olympia are on a spending binge, rewarding their special interest group supporters with your taxpayer dollars.

The Democrat-controlled State Senate just passed their own $70 billion spending bill -a budget that mean state spending has doubled in just the last 10 years. **And the biggest beneficiaries of their record-breaking spending spree are the state employee and public sector unions which will receive hefty pay raises - and then the unions will put big money back into Democrat campaign accounts.**

Meanwhile, taxpayers like you and your neighbors are left with the bill despite economic uncertainty and sky-high inflation already delivering a blow to your pocketbooks.

The majority of states across the nation - including such far-Left outposts as New York and California - have passed bills refunding taxpayers some of what they have overpaid to their state following the COVID-19 pandemic, using all the federal money sent to states to help out their citizens. But not in Washington State, under Jay Inslee and Democrat majorities in the legislature. **All we are getting are new taxes.**

Over the last couple of years, the liberals have burdened us with more taxes and refused to lift any existing burdens in the form of even modest tax breaks. Here are just a few ways they could have helped us this legislative session, all of which have been proposed:

* Reduce the regressive sales tax
* Ease the burdensome property tax
* Repeal the unconstitutional state income tax on capital gains
* Suspend the excessive state gas tax (third highest in the nation)
* Repeal the oppressive cap-and-tax scheme
* Abolish the unjust death tax
* Adjust the destructive business and occupation tax

But - of course - Democrats won't do any of those common-sense things in the face of massive budget surpluses. They have to reward their special-interest campaign donors after all.

Unfortunately, what remains of mainstream media outlets refuse to hold Democrats accountable for their record-breaking spending spree. In fact, they are just cheering Democrats on. **That 's why our work here at Shift WA is so important.**

[ **Will you consider helping us continue our efforts with an end-of-month contribution of $100, $50, or even $25 today?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657914:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r)

[ **We are behind on our goal - and your contribution will go a long way to helping us continue keeping an eye on Olympia as this current session is winding down and reporting back to you. **](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657914:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r)

Thank you,

The Shift WA team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61657916:WYgSLhDbN:m:1:2610672541:C5B866FFC101FDC992781AA05472718A:r)
---
|

If you would like to send this message to some of your friends, you can [click here](http://click.shiftwa.org/forwardthis/ft.php?mID=14171507&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&ch=49000b887de404a22f48ed48dd2d4356&schema=echo3) to do so.

You can also stay up to date on our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/shiftwa/) & [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShiftWA). If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | The year began on the heels of Democrats in Congress failing to secure a pathway to citizenship — and it hasn’t gotten any easier on us since. And now, we’re fighting back against a plan to restart cruel and inhumane family detentions. No matter what the rest of 2023 has in store, we know we’ll have what it takes to continue fighting back against anti-immigrant policies and empowering our communities. With the future of our democracy and reproductive freedom at stake, former Wisconsin State Treasurer Sarah Godlewski launched an initiative building on the power of pro-choice women.
The fall of Roe v. Wade reinstated Wisconsin’s cruel abortion ban from 1849 that provides no exceptions for rape or incest and could jail or fine doctors. But we know the right-wing won’t stop there. Governor Evers has already vetoed nine anti-abortion bills that passed the GOP-controlled legislature, and when he called for a special special to repeal the 1849 law, Republicans gaveled in and out in less than a minute.
At Women Win Wisconsin, we believe the key to stopping the GOP is to activate the overwhelming majority of voters who support reproductive freedom. A recent Marquette University Law School poll showed 80% of Wisconsin voters are concerned with the change in abortion policy now that abortion is illegal in the state. These voters can make the difference in Wisconsin races that are often decided by only a few hundred votes.
Women Win Wisconsin will make sure pro-choice voters know exactly who’s going to fight for their reproductive rights and freedoms. We back pro-choice women running in Wisconsin’s most competitive races, and we’re excited to support Democratic victories up and down the ballot.
There are critical spring elections on Tuesday, April 4, 2023.

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
We are living in a time where Satan no longer hides, but the world is so dark people still don’t see him.

We must let our light shine because light exposes darkness.
**The insidious truth about the so-called TikTok ban**
As one of our campaign volunteers put it, the RESTRICT Act (S. 686), aka the TikTok ban, is nothing more than the digital Patriot Act 2.0.
The RESTRICT Act would allow the government to access all of the data on your video devices if it is a service that over 1,000,000 people use; THIS INCLUDES SERVICES LIKE RING DOORBELL/INHOME SECURITY CAMERAS and so much more.
A VPN won't help you get around this, either. If caught using a privacy device such as a VPN, you will face up to 20 years in prison AND/OR up to **$1,000,000** in fines.
Let's talk about TikTok for a moment.
Y'all know I'm pretty raw most of the time, and this particular topic is no exception.
**The so-called TikTok ban is a Trojan horse for even more government control.**
Suppose anyone thinks China needs an app like TikTok to spy on us or mine our data. In that case, they are utterly clueless about how modern technology works.
Does anyone think 'big tech' isn't already in bed with 'big daddy government?'
The fact is, several people may hate TikTok. Still, no one can deny the irony of big daddy government wanting to ban the #1 platform adopted by younger millennials and Gen Z. This is a platform many use to reach the next generation by exposing deep-state lies.
This reeks of typical status quo establishment B.S. to me.
We need to use these tools, not become one.
And anyone who doesn't like TikTok doesn't have to use it.
**President Trump's ****Indictment**
On March 19, 2023, at 3:54 pm CST, I released an official statement regarding President Trump's impending indictment in New York. Please reply to this email if you missed it, and I'll happily resend it.

They wanted to fool everyone by labeling Trump's possible indictment as a conspiracy theory.

However, now it's a reality.

To anyone asleep over the last few years, I hope your eyes start opening.

Yesterday at 4:59 pm CST, I called on Gov. Ron DeSantis to mobilize the Florida National Guard to block the arrest - whether physical or administrative - of President Donald J. Trump.

Furthermore, I called upon my opponent, Rep. Dan Crenshaw, and every elected Republican to join me in calling on GOP leaders to do everything possible to prevent this abortion of justice.
**I Need Your Help!**
People are telling me to avoid the thought of Dan Crenshaw joining us in this fight, and I don't expect him to.

My opponent believes the 2020 election was legit and voted Yea on H.R. 6172, the U.S.A. Freedom Reauthorization Act, which reauthorized FISA and the Patriot Act.

In 2022, Dan Crenshaw outspent us 200 to 1. That means for every $1 our side spent, Crenshaw's campaign spent $200.

Can you imagine how many more votes we would've received if we had more resources?

If you've already contributed to our campaign, thank you! But we still have a long way to go, and the individual contribution limit has been raised from $2900 to $3300.

Could you contribute something, no matter how much or how little, to help me defeat Dan Crenshaw and restore your voice and Constitutional values to Washington, D.C.?
**Your contribution today of****any amount ****helps get the message****out to voters.**

name: Courier Newsroom
subject: Trump and Fox News are lying again
body:
After Donald Trump’s indictment, Fox News wasted no time amplifying Trump’s bad information to their millions of viewers.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=794%2E120351%2E_MbxqE)
Peter, after news broke about the grand jury indictment heard round the world, Donald Trump and _Fox News_ followed a familiar playbook.
First, Trump played the victim, calling the indictment a “witch hunt.” Next, _Fox News_ personalities like Tucker Carlson and Laura Ingraham doubled down on his baseless claims, painting the indictment as a political hit job by the Democratic Party.
**The truth is, no one, maybe not even Donald Trump, knows what’s in the indictment. But, Peter, we know**** _Fox News_****doesn’t care about the truth. They care about pushing Donald Trump’s lies because it’s good for ratings and their bottom line.**
[**The good news is that Courier’s network of eight local newsrooms is already fighting back in real time. Our talented team delivers fact-based reporting to online spaces where local news coverage is non-existent. To expand our reach into new communities, we need your help. Will you chip in $5 now to power our work?**](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3587?refcode=em-20230331&t=2&akid=794%2E120351%2E_MbxqE)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3587?refcode=em-20230331&t=3&akid=794%2E120351%2E_MbxqE)**
**Peter, correcting the record in real time won’t be easy.**
Trump and _Fox News_ already have a head start. But we’ve seen how dangerous our political environment can become if we let their bad information spread. With less than two years until the 2024 Presidential election, we can’t wait to build the infrastructure to fight back.
We have to get started today before it’s too late.
[**We know our model of fact-based local journalism is the best way to stop the spread of bad information, but the truth is, we can’t do this alone. To go toe to toe with Trump and Fox, our newsrooms rely on grassroots support from people like you. Please help us keep up this important work by contributing $5 today:**](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3587?refcode=em-20230331&t=4&akid=794%2E120351%2E_MbxqE)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3587?refcode=em-20230331&t=5&akid=794%2E120351%2E_MbxqE)**
Thank you,
Courier Newsroom

clean_body: We can’t let MAGA candidates win in Chicago, Wisconsin, or anywhere. | | | Peter, While Donald Trump was being indicted by a grand jury in NYC yesterday, what was Chicago mayoral candidate Paul Vallas up to? He was: • Continuing to add to the $1.1 million he's already raised from Trump mega-donors,1 • Getting fresh support from a SuperPAC run by Trump’s Secretary of Education Betsy DeVos,2 • Refusing to reject the endorsement of the same Chicago police union that backed Trump in 2020 and a few days ago threatened “blood in the streets” if Vallas were to lose,3 • And even reportedly receiving the vocal in-person support of a January 6th insurrectionist.4 We are proud to be working to elect Brandon Johnson as the next Mayor of Chicago because he is building a coalition that will fight for all of us — and all the latest polling shows that we can defeat MAGA forces and Republican big money in this race if we turn out our voters from now through Election Day on Tuesday. We can’t let MAGA candidates like this win in Chicago, Wisconsin, or anywhere. It wasn’t good enough to sit on the sidelines anymore. Not long after, I decided to run for Congress to challenge the Republican incumbent who represented my Orange County district.

Missouri school districts are removing books about the Holocaust due to a new law subjecting teachers to possible jail time for teaching allegedly “explicit material.” Ohio schools banned a children’s book called _It’s OK to be a Unicorn_ , accusing the author of “trying to turn kids gay.” Florida libraries pulled math textbooks with sidebar biographies of African American mathematicians and books about Hank Aaron and Roberto Clemente from the shelves.

Even in New Jersey, MAGA candidates have won school board races – in part because many voters don’t know who their school board candidates are. In those districts, teachers are already feeling pressure to change what and how they teach. The controversy, chaos, and expense to local school districts will keep spreading if we don’t put an end to this now.

Team Lizzie ----------Original Message---------- SENDER: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher DATE: Mar 30, 2023 [] It’s hard to believe it, but we’re fast approaching the first FEC reporting deadline of the year. It's at midnight tomorrow. [] All campaigns — including ours — set goals throughout the election cycle to make sure we have the resources we know we will need to run a strong campaign. [] It may seem like we set a lot of deadlines and are always emailing about them — but these quarterly deadlines are important. The end of the quarter marks the end of the reporting period, and we file our report on our finances with the Federal Election Commission. Of course, we always want a good report, because of what it means: a strong, well-funded campaign on track to win. After Friday, we will prepare our report of all the contributions to date for the FEC and I’m hoping for your support. Will you make a contribution before tomorrow? [] I’m grateful that there are so many dedicated supporters on #TeamLizzie who generously and consistently respond to these quarterly deadlines. Our campaign really is powered by people like you. Thank you again for all you do. Together, we can do anything, [] DONATE [] PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF LIZZIE FLETCHER, A JOINT FUNDRAISING COMMITTEE AUTHORIZED BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS AND LEADING PEOPLE FORWARD PAC. I wanted you to hear it from me, team:

It's now official: For the first time in American history, a president will face criminal charges because a grand jury has moved to indict former President Trump.

Let me be clear when I say, the indictment of a former president is a somber day for America. And it's time that we put our faith in the judicial system. Because no matter the individual or the crime, every American deserves protection provided to them in the Constitution and under the rule of law.

The stain that Donald Trump has left on our democracy is still being felt across our country. But let us neither celebrate nor destroy. As the former president continues to call for sympathy and violence in his name, let all of us condemn his efforts to incite chaos in this process.

Justice benefits us all, team. And throughout the next couple of weeks, Trump and his MAGA allies will be screaming from the rooftops about this “attack from the left.”

This moment is huge for those like myself who have been fighting back against Donald Trump for years. But the fight isn’t over.

I’m going to keep fighting until Trump is no longer a threat to our democracy. We must stand tall in this historic moment. Will you chip in whatever you can today so I can continue to fight until Trump is no longer a threat to our democracy? Greetings!
Could you please make a donation today?
The Republican Primary is less than 2 1/2 months away and we have our biggest campaign expenditures in the next couple of weeks to let voters know about the Republican Primary which will be held on Tuesday, June 20.
Our NEXT BIG fundraising deadline is Friday, March 31 at midnight, and I need YOUR help.
For the past 2 months I've been in session working hard for you. By law, state legislators are not allowed to collect campaign donations during session.
Now that session has adjourned, I need to quickly play catch up before our next big fundraising deadline on March 31, 2023 at midnight.
Would you please give your most generous donation today?
The Republican Primary is in just 2 1/2 months and I really need your help!
You may donate online or by mail. Our FIRST QUARTER FINANCIAL reporting number has to be a good one. My opponents have been able to raise money to run against me for several months, while I have been in session for 2 of the 3 months of the next financial reporting period.
I really need your help NOW.

Our next fundraising deadline is on Friday, March 31, LESS THAN 5 HOURS AWAY! Will you please give your most generous donation today?

Hi, friend, it’s Sen. Sherrod Brown from Ohio. I’ve spent my life fighting for the Dignity of Work – and I mean all work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I’ll fight for you.
I’m running for reelection so I can keep fighting for workers and families in the Senate – but I need your help. Analysts at _CNN_ say I’m one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot – and national Republicans are already launching attack ads against me.
**The battle for Senate control could all come down to Ohio – so please, I’m personally asking: [Will you give $5 or more before our FEC deadline tonight to help defend this battleground seat and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/61057506/399055739/691330013?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk92-fr-nd-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTNhZmRmMC1mNmNmLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rqft98CW28qZov8ljqLJ1OVV477WEYBOkBfPCAmM4LY=)**
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. And I’ll be honest with you: The Ohio I live in now looks a lot different than the one I grew up in. I’m fighting in the Senate every day to bring those jobs back, to build our economy by investing in the middle class, and to ensure hard work pays off for every American.
But I’m facing my toughest race yet – in a state Donald Trump won by 8 points. Last year’s Ohio Senate race was one of the most costly and competitive in the nation, and _NBC News_ reports that this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”
**The long and short of it is, I can’t win – and Democrats simply can’t hold onto our narrow Senate majority – if we don’t have strong grassroots support from folks like you.**
**[That’s why I’m asking for your support today, friend: Please, will you chip in $5 or more now so we can win in Ohio and defend the Senate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/61057507/399055740/691330013?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk92-fr-nd-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTNhZmRmMC1mNmNmLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rqft98CW28qZov8ljqLJ1OVV477WEYBOkBfPCAmM4LY=)**
With gratitude,

Sherrod Brown

body:
You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles

| This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ab543919714c42bfb8b545db1f0a2283&_e=IhU1AJGwaUUGHTRnpQydO5tdeT7_xD_DDcd_jV5koyj-8Qv63p6wIijHt2TntkiezdU69-1wWYC0LsdzraRI4KzmgiaYXatCCjE_OH4v4FWUGOnCUDVjmf9W-EzVwH7vOe0G6R23KfSV9EhFPSsL-hA553sijchXZEMKTqJsTSOSJGUBlnUZv108Dh1XaUaxl-SOpgcsBcoEAdlGUxJXBln8KcfM5j7PQaDesN03ZHVL-agWAANN8FVzSTWQMV-m27sZaMZp96ITFj9LnXe7ss5bvKNuARJHSqCSRQ9Z5_QpsypkkVnHlARs94oZETfc8ep03G2lJJE6k_Zq6wchajLRT2QDVhkI-DB9JBuFsl9JHi-gC3av7gzjSn6h98nsrBdseDFZyIqHUuoJcokW_vO56SwaUDW_jgR4ODCUrxA%3D)

| |
Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. **That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ab543919714c42bfb8b545db1f0a2283&_e=IhU1AJGwaUUGHTRnpQydO5tdeT7_xD_DDcd_jV5koyj-8Qv63p6wIijHt2TntkiezdU69-1wWYC0LsdzraRI4KzmgiaYXatCCjE_OH4v4FWUGOnCUDVjmf9W-EzVwH7vOe0G6R23KfSV9EhFPSsL-hA553sijchXZEMKTqJsTSOSJGUBlnUZv108Dh1XaUaxl-SOpgcsBcoEAdlGUxJXBln8KcfM5j7PQaDesN03ZHVL-agWAANN8FVzSTWQMV-m27sZaMZp96ITFj9LnXe7sg10e5NVvxbUWnohS0qdONhy6RyUC96ABxmkOHHJYCWAxh39-wB3-FfJSIoVmOXwHiXPBOLZjiMgjHkhct6kV33twrYsOK17QAywsblNyWOphvmqkyif-kUEBaANYieZ_ifvgJylQxABfUUJObgiDww%3D)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

subject: DEADLINE MIDNIGHT: National Environmental Policy Act in jeopardy -- we need your help [ 3X your impact ].
body:
__TRIPLE MATCH: ACTIVE |
---

|
We really need your help, Peter -- our triple match ends at midnight and we are still $5,000 short of our $40,000 goal. We're so close to the finish line -- [can you help us get there with a gift right now?](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fe_kj_)

Yesterday, the House voted 225-204 to pass H.R.1, a bill we're calling the "Polluters Over People Act."

**We 're now in a critical moment.** We could see a similar proposal in the Senate to massively expand oil and gas drilling and gut the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) -- the law that requires environmental impact studies and allows communities to weigh in and push back on large or particularly devastating projects.

**With a bill expected to drop soon, we 're quickly ramping up a campaign to pressure swing senators to vote NO.** The problem is, after months of back-to-back must-win campaigns, the only way we continue is with your help. Please, triple your impact:

[Help us keep up the pressure: we are so close to reaching our goal. Every contribution we receive -- even as little as $5 -- will go THREE TIMES as far through midnight tonight.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fe_kj_)
|
---
**[**MIDNIGHT DEADLINE:
TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT >> **](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

This situation is serious, Peter. Here's why we can't stand to lose the protections set forth by the NEPA:
* It means gutting the rules that require environmental impact studies before plans get approved.
* It means removing peoples' ability to have a say in what happens in their communities.
* It means putting the lives of countless endangered species on public lands at risk.

This could truly be the difference between a clean energy future supported by science, and one that intentionally pollutes our lands, waters, and air for decades -- all in the interest of Big Oil.****

But there is some good news -- the environmental movement has a real shot at making sure NEPA remains protected, **but not without your help.**

[We're down to the wire, Peter. Triple your impact -- even if it's just $5. Your support is what makes our campaigns possible.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fe_kj_)

---
**[**MIDNIGHT DEADLINE:
TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT >> **](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

Thanks so much for your support. We know we can win this with you by our side.

Onward,
Team LCV

body:
Join Us and Make a Difference in your community and our state!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| | Today, we’re celebrating Transgender Day of Visibility to lift up trans and nonbinary people as incredibly valued members of our community. In the face of extremists’ attacks on LGBTQ+ communities across the U.S., we’re more committed than ever to speaking up and fighting back. In 2023, extremist lawmakers have proposed a horrifying 430+ anti-LGBTQ+ bills — including an appalling wave of anti-trans legislation. That includes SB 140 in Georgia, which restricts gender-affirming care for trans youth and criminalizes healthcare providers for following medical best practices. An incredible coalition fought back against SB 140, but unfortunately Governor Kemp ultimately signed it into law. It's vital to use our voices to support LGBTQ+ inclusion and equity nationwide. The truth is, it’s the same lawmakers who are restricting the freedom to vote who are also attacking the LGBTQ+ community. Fair Fight Action’s vision for Georgia — and our democracy — includes everyone. That means making sure that our queer, trans, and nonbinary neighbors are protected by our laws. Today and every day, we’ll continue to work towards a democracy that includes all of us, and where no one faces attacks on their identity and their existence. [_**It's going to take all of us working together to build a more inclusive democracy. If you can, make a contribution today as we continue this critical work.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/61062313/399071048/872471362?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20230331_f_trans_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjg5MDg3My0wMWQwLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pli-g1ad6068QemDgf2zc_Zxvw0nfk0CDwDVRw1XLGY=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/61062317/399071051/872471362?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20230331_f_trans_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjg5MDg3My0wMWQwLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pli-g1ad6068QemDgf2zc_Zxvw0nfk0CDwDVRw1XLGY=)

body:
Peter,
Did you see Joe's message below?
We only have hours left before the FEC deadline and we're still about $25,000 behind our goal. Please help us hit our fundraising number at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/32RoMfusHTFZVBd67630SLoA/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg) ASAP.
TIME IS RUNNING OUT! TODAY IS THE DEADLINE
$11,600, $5000, $1000, $500, $100, $50, or even $5 helps and we are grateful for any donation you can spare!
Click [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/32RoMfusHTFZVBd67630SLoA/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg) and help us hit our goal before time is up!
Thank you,
Erin Van Natta
Field Organizer
Joe Kent for Congress

* * *
**From:** Joe Kent
**Sent:** Friday, March 31, 2023 8:45 AM
**Subject:** My greatest weakness (Personal)
Peter,
When I first began my campaign for Congress, I had to do a lot of things I'd never had to do before during the twenty years I spent in the military.
Some of these new things I enjoy a lot, like holding town halls where I can talk to voters about how we have to defeat the woke left that is destroying our country. I also appreciate hearing from people from all different walks of life and from all over my district, sharing their hopes and dreams, fears and concerns.
However, the one thing I really dislike doing, more than anything else, is asking for money. No matter how often I've done it, it still makes me a little uncomfortable.
But I also accept the reality that if we are going to have any chance to flip this seat, I need to raise money - a lot of money.
And today is the last day of the quarter. We have a big report we need to file with the FEC that's a public measure of how successful we have been as a campaign.
So let me please ask you to make one more donation today, for as much as you can afford, at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/JCtAFzwIby6xAFJ0pZNDYw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg).
In my last race, a lot of factors played into the loss but the one overwhelming obstacle was that I was outspent six to one in the General Election. In a congressional district that's only narrowly Republican, it's very hard to overcome an opponent when they can financially overwhelm you that much.
We can't let that happen again.
It's absolutely vital that we flip this seat red in the next election. This district represents the Republican's BEST HOPE of picking up a seat anywhere in the country.
So please give what you can at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/JCtAFzwIby6xAFJ0pZNDYw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg).
I'll keep doing my part: talking to voters, knocking on doors, persuading the people of this district that I'm the best person to go to DC and represent their values, and, yes, raising money.
Please help by doing your part. Make a contribution today and help us have a successful financial report for the first quarter at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/JCtAFzwIby6xAFJ0pZNDYw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg).
Respectfully,
Joe Kent

| Peter --

The last few weeks have been hard. We've waited for the former President to potentially be indicted in criminal court. We've watched as people -- children -- have lost their lives to gun violence and mass shootings. We've been subjected to disgusting attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, trans rights, and reproductive rights. And we've done all of it while continuing to live through a pandemic and the climate crisis.

But through it all, I'm still hopeful -- and that's all because of you. [**In 30 hours, we have our first End of Quarter deadline of the year -- and I'm hoping you'll chip in to help me finish strong and keep our movement moving forward toward a better future.**](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=b55c452f32&e=2de202398d)

I've watched as our movement has stood together over the last six years to create a first-in-the-nation municipally funded abortion fund in order to make and keep New York a national abortion haven, and to fund the transgender navigator program to ensure trans and gender nonconforming New Yorkers have an easier time accessing the care they need. I've stood alongside you as we've fought car congestion by building more bike lanes and investing in the MTA. And I've been alongside you as we mourn every life lost to gun violence by fighting harder to ban weapons of war from our streets to keep each other safe in honor of those we couldn't.

[**Can I count on you to chip in any amount before midnight tomorrow to keep me -- and us all -- in this fight?**](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=0fd05337bd&e=2de202398d)
---
| Thank you for inspiring me daily,
Carlina

name: Adam Schiff
subject: A nation of laws, not of men
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| There will be some who celebrate this moment. But as much as I believe that Trump has been a serial law-breaker, I won’t be one of them.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=2053%2E5257348%2EWdJJSK)
Derek —
I wanted to share some thoughts with you after a really momentous day. Never before has a President of the United States — current or former — been indicted.
**There will be some who celebrate this moment. But as much as I believe that Trump has been a serial lawbreaker, I won’t be one of them.**
It’s a sober moment for our democracy. And the charges against the former president, although essential to equal enforcement of the law, will nonetheless introduce another trying chapter in our history.
All too often our criminal justice system hasn’t worked fairly. All too often, those who can afford the best lawyers can put off any reckoning for their criminal conduct until justice delayed is justice denied, while others face a swift and formidable accounting. This has been all too clear in the case of Donald Trump.
Donald Trump has made a career of evading justice. He’s worked tirelessly to tie the legal system into knots in not just this case, but the other serious investigations into his handling of classified materials, his inciting an insurrection, and his pressuring election officials to overturn the election.
Saving his own skin may be the driving motivation for the former president, but the success of his efforts to evade accountability have had systemic impacts. They have weakened our institutions and bred disrespect of the law.
Ultimately, this has been a big part of Trump’s legacy — weakening our democracy, weakening the rule of law, and weakening our trust in our system.
He's used a playbook we’ve seen time and time again by other would-be despots around the world.
**Ultimately, those with wealth and power must be held to account for the rule of law to truly matter. Especially if they can use that influence to tear down our faith in the justice system.**
Donald Trump will finally have his day in court. And may have many more in the days and weeks to come.
And as he does, we must redouble our efforts to strengthen our democracy, rebuild trust in the rule of law, and ensure that those who hold office uphold their oath and defend the Constitution as they are sworn to do.
This is our challenge, and we must meet it.
Thanks for reading,
Adam

subject: We Need A Revival ❤️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress** [Unsubscribe](http://links
body:
TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | |
---
| | |
---
| | **We Need A Revival ❤️**
---
| |
---
My heart aches for the people of my cherished home state as we all process this week’s unfathomable tragedy. I pray for the families who are a part of The Covenant School community in the wake of this excruciating loss, and I want them to know they are not alone. No one should ever experience the type of grief they will navigate for the rest of their lives. It’s difficult to comprehend why someone would commit such a heinous act, especially against innocent children. We must work together to learn more about mental illness and the issues that lead to this type of senseless violence. As we continue to uncover more about the events that led up to this tragedy, I believe transparency is vital. I have faith that Tennessee law enforcement will handle this investigation with the utmost care and consideration. This is the best way to provide the answers these families and the entire country deserve. I will continue to have important conversations with my colleagues and friends on both sides of the aisle to find common ground. Today and always, I want you to know my thoughts are with those who are grieving. May you find comfort in knowing that folks across Tennessee are here to love and support you. America needs a revival. My hope is that we can all work together to make this country a safe place for future generations. Sincerely, Tim Burchett

body:
Hi Derek,

I know you’ve heard from my team a lot this week, and I appreciate you sticking with us.

Derek, asking for money is probably my least favorite part of campaigning, and I know it might feel like overkill to be so focused on hitting monthly goals this early in the campaign. But the truth is, National Republicans have already identified me as a top target and it’s crucial that we prepare for whatever they throw our way.

Tonight is a big night for our campaign. After tonight, my team will file our fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission, and then everyone – including Kevin McCarthy and the dark money groups that spent almost $8 million against us last year – will be able to see the strength of our grassroots movement. That’s why it’s so important to me that we put forward the strongest showing possible.

Derek, we only need to raise $487 more to hit our goal and end March on a strong note. If you’re able to chip in to help us close the gap, here’s a link just for you:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/del-email-march2023?refcode=em_fr_2023.03.31_b2_cd_all&amount=15

Thanks again for sticking with us,

Chris

Friend, Because Rashida is unafraid to lead on bold issues―from human rights to economic justice to environmental sanity―**she is constantly under attack by those seeking to maintain the unjust status quo.** **From taking on billionaire bullies to greedy banks to polluting fossil fuel corporations, Rashida is unmoved in centering marginalized communities in our shared struggle for justice and equity for all** ―fighting back against policies that for too long have put profits over our rights and our health. As a strong woman of color with multiple marginalized identities, Rashida has to work tremendously hard to achieve those goals. In a recent interview with Bustle on “ignor[ing] the haters,” Rashida said:
> _“I’m always outworking the hate. I feel like I have to work 10 times harder, which I hear from other women too, especially women of color. When I see others [calling out power structures], I think of it as courage. Men do it and they’re ‘courageous.’ I do it and I’m called a ‘lightning rod.’ Folks are so incredibly obsessed with policing my words and how I get things done—not the fact that I got it done.”_

With your support, I was able to flip my home district BLUE in 2022, and now we need to work even harder to defend it.

body:

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Bear cubs are STILL being shot in their dens while they sleep, and it’s completely legal!** A mama bear ventures from her den after braving the winter cold all season long, desperate to find life-giving nourishment for her cubs. Weak from hibernation, she doesn’t notice the vicious trophy hunters lurking in the trees, **_waiting to take advantage of her defenselessness. With just one bullet, her babies are orphaned -- left starving and alone in their den, waiting hopelessly for their mama’s return._** Without their mothers, bear cubs are left to _**STARVE, FREEZE, or get caught in the crossfire of merciless trophy hunters.**_ Yet trophy hunters and Big Oil lobbies are pushing harder than ever to REMOVE CRITICAL ENDANGERED SPECIES PROTECTIONS for threatened grizzlies and take over the lands they call home. [**Please, sign your name NOW and tell the FWS to expand protections for grizzly bears before the loss is too great! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1700944?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1700945?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
At one time, it was illegal for ruthless trophy hunters to kill bear cubs in their dens -- and for good reason! But the Trump Administration OVERTURNED this ban, __**leaving helpless baby animals at the mercy of callous trophy hunters killing for sport.**__ What’s worse -- Trump actually **_incentivized_** prize hunters with HANDOUTS! And now, **it’s perfectly legal for sleeping bear cubs to get shredded apart by bullets in their own homes.**
If delisted, grizzlies could be treated as horribly as vulnerable wolves currently are -- with Wyoming _**allowing a shoot-on-sight**_ approach across the state. Pro-trophy hunting officials are looking to STEAMROLL the protections grizzlies still have, which means _**grizzly bears are coming dangerously close to being caught in the crosshairs during the next hunt**_ \-- we can’t let it come to that, Friend.
[**Please, Friend -- stand with us and add your name NOW to prevent greedy interests from STRIPPING AWAY the protections grizzlies still have! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1700946?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: | | | | | == ---|---|--- | | URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Bear cubs are STILL being shot in their dens while they sleep, and it’s completely legal! A mama bear ventures from her den after braving the winter cold all season long, desperate to find life-giving nourishment for her cubs. Weak from hibernation, she doesn’t notice the vicious trophy hunters lurking in the trees, waiting to take advantage of her defenselessness. With just one bullet, her babies are orphaned -- left starving and alone in their den, waiting hopelessly for their mama’s return. Without their mothers, bear cubs are left to STARVE, FREEZE, or get caught in the crossfire of merciless trophy hunters. Yet trophy hunters and Big Oil lobbies are pushing harder than ever to REMOVE CRITICAL ENDANGERED SPECIES PROTECTIONS for threatened grizzlies and take over the lands they call home. == | == At one time, it was illegal for ruthless trophy hunters to kill bear cubs in their dens -- and for good reason! But the Trump Administration OVERTURNED this ban, leaving helpless baby animals at the mercy of callous trophy hunters killing for sport. What’s worse -- Trump actually incentivized prize hunters with HANDOUTS! And now, it’s perfectly legal for sleeping bear cubs to get shredded apart by bullets in their own homes. If delisted, grizzlies could be treated as horribly as vulnerable wolves currently are -- with Wyoming allowing a shoot-on-sight approach across the state. Pro-trophy hunting officials are looking to STEAMROLL the protections grizzlies still have, which means grizzly bears are coming dangerously close to being caught in the crosshairs during the next hunt \-- we can’t let it come to that, Friend. == == Thank you for taking urgent action to protect grizzlies! Don Tracy and the Illinois GOP Election Integrity Program's Message to Local GOP Leaders: "Sorry, But We Can't Help" (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/don-tracy-and-the-illinois-gop-election-integrity-programs-message-to-local-gop-leaders-sorry-but-we-cant-help.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Illinois Review has recently learned that when a local Republican leader raised the alarm about a Democratic-controlled county clerk’s office playing games with assigning Republicans to serve as election judges, IL GOP Chair Don Tracy and other IL GOP officials had a simple message for this concerned, local Republican leader who was desperate for some help and guidance: “Sorry, but we can’t help you.” Click to read more. (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/don-tracy-and-the-illinois-gop-election-integrity-programs-message-to-local-gop-leaders-sorry-but-we-cant-help.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Gun Owners Rally Second Amendment Rights in Springfield (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/isra-igold-2023.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The Illinois Gun Owner Lobby Day (IGOLD) is the most important demonstration of citizens promoting gun owners’ rights in the United States. On March 29, 2023, gun owners from across Illinois gathered at the state Capitol in Springfield to rally for their Second Amendment rights.

Organized by the Illinois State Rifle Association, IGOLD is a powerful display of solidarity and strength among gun owners. This year’s event was especially significant as it was held just months after Governor JB Pritzker signed into law a ban on assault-style weapons and high capacity magazines. Click to read more. (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/isra-igold-2023.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/isra-igold-2023.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

IL GOP Chair Don Tracy Silent, Abandons Republican School Board Candidates While IL Democratic Party Funds School Board Races Statewide (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/il-gop-chair-don-tracy-silent-abandons-republican-school-board-candidates-while-il-democratic-party-funds-school-board-races-statewide.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

As candidates prepare for municipal elections on April 4th, the Democratic Party of Illinois is hard at work, supporting school board candidates and allocating funding and resources to their campaigns.

In total, the Democratic Party of Illinois is spending $800,000 towards not only supporting candidates, but they are also funding a campaign that targets and attacks their conservative opponents – every day moms and dads – and especially single moms, who are running for a seat on their local school board.

Where’s IL GOP Chair Don Tracy and the leaders of the Republican Party of Illinois?

They are silent, and nowhere to be found. Click to read more. (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/il-gop-chair-don-tracy-silent-abandons-republican-school-board-candidates-while-il-democratic-party-funds-school-board-races-statewide.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Opinion: Portland's Retail Exodus a Frightening Warning for Other U.S. Cities (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/opinion-portlands-retail-exodus-a-frightening-warning-for-other-u-s-cities.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In recent weeks, Wal-Mart and Cracker Barrel have made national news by announcing that they are finally closing down their remaining locations in the Portland, Oregon area.

What they know – for a fact – is simply that the math doesn’t work anymore. No matter how much they manage to sell, it doesn’t make up for the cost of staff and ingredients, the risk of theft, their insurance premiums, their rent and taxes. They experiment with price increases until they see sales fall, then they have to admit the simple truth: they cannot do business under these circumstances.
Click to read more. (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/opinion-portlands-retail-exodus-a-frightening-warning-for-other-u-s-cities.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/opinion-portlands-retail-exodus-a-frightening-warning-for-other-u-s-cities.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

California Dreaming? (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/california-dreaming.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Is it possible that our legislators are trying their best to make Illinois the California of the Midwest, without the mountains or beautiful weather? Our Governors, most certainly, are competing. Both have wildly inflated egos, both ignored their own directives during the height of the pandemic, and both have designs on the White House. Click to read more. (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/california-dreaming.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Witnesses: Keith Pekau Harasses, Intimidates Female Orland Fire District Candidates, Follows Them in His Car While They Knocked on Doors (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/witnesses-keith-pekau-harasses-intimidates-female-orland-fire-dist-candidates-follows-them-in-his-car-while-they-knocked-on-doors.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06662aa809-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_03_31_01_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-06662aa809-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

This past weekend, Orland Fire Protection District candidates Angela Greenfield and Tina Zekich joined an army of volunteers – many of them off-duty firefighters who braved the cold to knock on doors for their campaigns – were caught off guard, when they were met by hecklers, who followed the group around neighborhoods in their vehicle as a form of harassment and intimidation.

The driver of the vehicle harassing the off-duty firefighters and volunteers? Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau.

clean_body: | = Peter, I’m not going to sugarcoat it: This is a make-or-break cycle for Democrats nationwide.= There is so much at stake right now, from abortion rights and voting rights to Republican threats to derail our economy and undermine Social Security and Medicare. Candidates with public service backgrounds – from educators to firefighters to veterans – know first-hand the real-life impact of policies and their direct work in strengthening their communities. That makes them uniquely qualified for public office. Over the next year, we’re planning to add staff, invest in candidate recruitment and services, and build a digital-first program in target House districts. Tonight at midnight, we'll be closing the books on our first quarter of the year. Peter,

Tonight at midnight, we'll be closing the books on our first quarter of the year. This is the most important deadline we've faced this year since it marks the first time our fundraising numbers will be made public.

That's why my team and I set an ambitious online fundraising goal to reach before then, but we're still coming up a little short.

We can't afford to miss this goal. Earlier this month, national Republicans listed my seat as a top target in 2024 and I already have a Republican opponent in the race. This race is starting to heat up and it's only a matter of time before the attacks against me start.

I've always said WA-08 is a true purple district and it's clear we have another tough fight ahead of us. Keeping our fundraising on track is critical to ensure we are prepared for anything that Republicans throw our way – and that starts with reaching our end-of-quarter goal before midnight.

name: Whip Jazz Lewis
subject: ICYMI 🎙️
body:
Jazz Lewis, Democrat for Progress

Friends,

Today, I had the incredible pleasure of joining Kojo Nnamdi and Tom Sherwood for The Politics Hour to discuss our key priorities and accomplishments this session. We talked about our work to move the FBI headquarters to Prince George’s County, ensure that equity is key in our guidance on cannabis permits, and that we protect access to health care including a woman’s right to choose.

CHECK IT OUT » [https://wamu.org/story/23/03/31/house-republicans-dc-officials-police-reform-maryland-fbi-hq/]

This is just a snapshot of what we have been able to accomplish in the last 79 days. I’m really proud of the work we have done this session from giving working families a tax break to expanding Title IX to significant investments in our community’s infrastructure.

With just ten days left in the legislative session, we’re not done yet and look forward to sharing all our progress in the next few weeks.

Thanks for being with me,

Jazz

Yesterday was a BIG day, Peter.
**Why? Because yesterday I joined my Democratic colleagues in introducing the Women’s Health Protection Act, a bill that would guarantee abortion care as a human right across the entire country.**
After the conservative-stacked Supreme Court gutted Roe v. Wade last year, Republican-controlled states like Texas quickly moved to eliminate abortion rights—criminalizing reproductive care that millions of people count on.
Without federal protections, abortion rights have been under assault across the country. But the Women’s Health Protection Act would codify those rights, restoring the right for patients to make decisions about their own bodies. But first, we need to pass it—which is why I need your help.
**FIRSTNAME, today is the last day of the fundraising quarter. Peter, what happened here?
Earlier this week, I reached out to this powerful community asking for support – and the initial response was _overwhelming_.
Up until this morning, we were well within arms reach of hitting our end-of-quarter goal of activating 1,000 Team James Memberships. But then, out of nowhere it seems, donations came to a STANDSTILL. **Now, we're on the verge of falling short of our membership goal by just 203 donations.**
Sorry for the bluntness, but I'm disappointed, Peter. This first end-of-quarter is one of the biggest milestones _yet_ of my new term as attorney general, and now we're in serious danger of falling short.

This is important, Peter. | | | Hey, Peter – did you get Nat's latest note? If you missed it, we shared some crucial information on how United Rural Democrats are doing this election season. **Unfortunately, we asked our finance team to run the latest numbers, and we're still $500 away from our end-of-quarter fundraising goal.** Here's why that matters. We're supporting a national slate of candidates, dozens of organizers, and thousands of Democratic voters in rural areas. They’re the reason why I fight for the dignity of work -- because no matter what kind of work you do, it should pay off. clean_body: In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a donation between my reelection campaign and the DNC, but before I do, I wanted to take a second to explain why I need your support. | | Hi Derek -- Senator Sherrod Brown here. Growing up in Ohio, I was brought up in a community of autoworkers, ironworkers, carpenters, and electricians. I spent my summers working on my family’s farm, learning from the working people who have shaped me into the person I am today. They’re the reason why I fight for the dignity of work -- because no matter what kind of work you do, it should pay off. I’ve battled against broken policies that put corporate profits ahead of workers and families, long championed voting rights as the former Ohio Secretary of State, and pushed for lowering health care costs for seniors and growing families. At the end of the day, it comes down to this, Derek: I’ve spent my life fighting for working people and families across America. We still have more to do, so I’m running for reelection in 2024. Will you split a $10 donation between my campaign and the DNC before tonight's end-of-quarter deadline? As the only remaining statewide Democrat in Ohio, the battle for the Senate majority could come down to my race -- and I’m asking you to help me continue fighting for working people across the country. While 2024 seems like a long way away, getting ready early could be the deciding factor on how I do next November. It’s early donations that make all the difference in elections, it’s how we build the foundation needed to win -- especially since this could be my toughest race yet. Thank you for standing with me, Sherrod Sherrod Brown U.S. Senator, Ohio The DNC's Congressional Split Series helps fundraise for and raise awareness around down-ballot Democrats in some of the most important races across the country. Serving as the executive director of EMILYs List since 2017 has been an honor and a privilege. _(And being introduced as "Emily from EMILYs List" never got old!)_ Today is my last day, and I'm excited to send one final email about the power of EMILYs List and this community.

EMILYs List continues to change the face of power in this country by electing a diverse group of Democratic pro-choice women to office, up and down the ballot, and all across the country. Since 1985, that impact has been possible because of two things: The brave candidates who step up to run, and you, the supporters who have their back.

While it may be the end of the month, the end of the fiscal quarter, and the end of my time at EMILYs List, it's not the end of anything, really — just a turn of the page to a new chapter for me, and the start of another crucial election cycle for EMILYs List.

[**I hope you'll join me at this vital moment and support EMILYs List with a contribution before our first End-of-Quarter goal of the new cycle. Please, donate now.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/61071793/399098451/27957066?sourceid=1048843&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGIyZmVkZS0xOWQwLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9W7I_OoLVOJIzUkLXwjhhgFSMS-tKdVwFgG-Tazrha8=&emci=f89072ff-f7cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=7db2fede-19d0-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=5177934)

I became an EMILYs List member in 2008, and I carry my annual membership card with me _to this day_. Making long-term change in American politics takes time. It also takes early investment, sustained commitment, and an unflappable belief in our central mission to elect more Democratic pro-choice women everywhere.

When those pieces are in place, the work we do here changes the world. Just in the last few years at EMILYs List we have made history and broken glass ceilings by helping build and sustain majorities in Congress and state legislatures, expand pro-choice majorities at every level of office, elect a record number of governors, and elect a woman as vice president of the United States. I'm so proud to have been at EMILYs List to be a part of it all.

Change of that magnitude is made possible by starting _now_ , early in the election cycle, and pledging to be part of the fight for the days, weeks, months, and years ahead. Thank you for the support you've shown EMILYs List (and me!) for the past six years. ****I am counting on you to keep supporting this organization that means _so_ much to me and is so vital to the future of our country. Derek, is there anything I can say that would convince you to
chip in ahead of my campaign’s first major FEC fundraising deadline at
midnight?

What if I reminded you that Kevin McCarthy kicked me off the House
Intelligence Committee that I have chaired and served as the top Democrat
for years — the day before we announced this campaign? And that he did so
without putting it to a vote of the House.

Or that Matt Gaetz filed legislation in the House the day we announced to
prevent me from receiving classified information — and called it the
PENCIL Act, a reference to the far right’s many “pencil neck” attacks
against me?

Or that Tucker Carlson is attacking me virtually every week on his
primetime Fox News show?

Or that Kevin McCarthy is instructing the California Republican Party that

campaign?

they are terrified of the accountability I will bring to that body, the
